description: Koutecká Vertikála is a 2.5 km uphill race with 510 metres of elevation gain, held at the Kouty nad Desnou ski resort. The race has a staggered start and is part of the Chlapácký běh series, which includes cross-country races in Šumperk and the surrounding area. This race offers a demanding, dynamic uphill run, ideal for fans of mountain running and vertical challenges.

name: Rasokros
description: Rasokros is a running race in Krč Forest in Prague 4, offering men a 7.5 km course and women a 2.5 km course. The race is part of the SABZO series and is suitable for runners looking for an enjoyable cross-country run in a natural setting. The route runs through forest terrain and offers the chance to enjoy a run in a peaceful part of Prague. The race is open to the general public and welcomes all runners who want to test their strength in this attractive event.

name: 3. Pekelný kilometr
description: Pekelný kilometr is an uphill running race held at the Peklák ski resort in Česká Třebová. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026 series and features a 1 km course with staggered starts, climbing the ski slope over grass, snow and paths depending on the current weather. The children’s race starts at 17:00, and the main 1 km race begins at 18:00. The race is suitable for a wide range of age categories and is known for its atmosphere and challenging climb.

name: BĚKODO – květen III
description: BĚKODO is the traditional 40th edition of a running series in Teplice, intended for recreational, fitness and competitive runners aged 15 and over. The series consists of the ten best-scoring starts during the season; in the event of a tie in points, the better time decides. The time limit for official timing is 35 minutes; runners who exceed it are recorded as 35+. A separate Mladé BĚKODO series is available for younger runners. The event is organized by TJ Lokomotiva Teplice and BK Běkodo.

name: Tolarova pětka
description: Tolarova Pětka is a running race held in Stříbro, offering a 5-kilometer course. The race is part of the Sdružení vytrvalců Stříbro calendar and is intended for amateur and recreational runners. The route runs through the town park and is suitable for all age groups. After the race, there is a results ceremony and refreshments for participants.

name: Černovírská osmička
description: Černovírská osmička is a traditional running race organized by the Central Moravian Association of Endurance Sports in Olomouc-Černovír. The race is part of the Haná Running Cup, which offers courses of various lengths and is open to all runners, regardless of age or performance level. The course runs through the picturesque landscape of the Olomouc Region and is suitable for beginners and experienced endurance runners alike. The organizers emphasize a relaxed atmosphere and high-quality race organization.

name: Kamenická 15
description: Kamenická 15 is a traditional running race in Kamenice near Jihlava. Adult runners take on a 15 km loop along paved roads and paths. Younger runners can choose from shorter 1.75 km and 0.4 km loops on paved roads in the village. The course passes through scenic spots in the surrounding area, including the hamlet of Brodek, Zátiší Chateau and the Cípy forester’s lodge, and finishes at the starting point. The race is suitable for a wide range of ages, from 3 years old, and offers a pleasant atmosphere, refreshments and prizes for winners and young participants.

name: Kapličkobraní
description: Kapličkobraní is a non-competitive charity event that follows a route past 13 chapels around Ludgeřovice and Markvartovice, with a total of 14 stops including the finish. The 10–12 km route is suitable for running, walking, cycling, Nordic walking, or even taking a stroller. The event has a deeper purpose, and all proceeds go to the family of Jan Rieml to support his sons Šimon and Matěj. Participants receive a commemorative magnet, light refreshments at the finish, and a tasting of sacramental wine at one of the chapels. Kapličkobraní received an award for the best low-budget sports project for small organizations.

name: Běh mimoňským parkem
description: The Run through Mimoň Park is a race held in the chateau park in Mimoň, offering a flat course on paved paths along the Ploučnice River. The race is divided into 7-kilometre laps, with 7 km and 21 km distances available. The event is suitable for the general public as well as competitive runners and is organised by Lenka Zeťová. The main category starts at 17:00, while the first category starts at 9:00. The race is part of the Czech Running Club and is held under the auspices of the Czech Athletics Federation.

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Nové Město na Moravě
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Nové Město na Moravě is a charity event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps preserve historical memories. The race takes place in and around Vysočina Arena, with 2 km, 5 km and 10 km routes; the 5 km route is one lap and the 10 km route is two laps. The event offers timed and untimed runs, including family and children’s races, and is suitable for the general public, including pupils, students and seniors, who may be eligible for a discount on the entry fee. The start and finish are at the Vysočina Arena stadium, where facilities include changing rooms, baggage storage and refreshments.

name: Běh osvobození – Lišanská silniční sedmička
description: The Liberation Run – Lišany Road Seven is a traditional 7 km road race between the villages of Lišany and Lužná. The race takes place on a quiet third-class road and is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup. The start is in Lišany, where registration also takes place, and the finish is by the U Hřiště restaurant. The race has four men’s and two women’s categories and offers cash prizes, as well as a bonus for breaking the course records. The start time is 11:15. Entries are accepted on site on race day.

name: Běh Emericha Ratha
description: The Emerich Rath Run is a revived cross-country race held in Broumov, inviting runners to take part in the picturesque surroundings of Schroll Park near Cyklodům Broumov. The race offers an opportunity to enjoy a run in nature, with access to amenities such as bike rental, luggage storage, and an e-bike charging station. Registration takes place in the morning before the start, traditionally at 10:00. The organizers warmly invite all runners to join this sporting event with its friendly atmosphere.

name: Tuháčkův běh
description: Tuháček’s Run is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Chrást u Příbrami as part of the Brdy Running Cup. The main race is approximately 8.2 km long and runs mostly along paved and gravel cycle paths around Chrást. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who can take part in dedicated children’s races. The main race starts at 11:00 at the Valcha complex. The event offers a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to compete with other runners in beautiful natural surroundings.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton České Budějovice 2026
location: České Budějovice, Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., Jihočeský
description: Mattoni Running Festival České Budějovice 2026 invites you to an unforgettable half marathon through the heart of the city’s historic centre. The start is on the second-largest square in the Czech Republic, Náměstí Přemysla Otakara II., and the course offers a unique atmosphere and views of historic buildings and special places. This race is part of the popular RunCzech running series and is suitable for all runners who want to experience the charm of the South Bohemian capital during a day of sport. Join thousands of runners and enjoy a great sporting event in České Budějovice.

name: Chlum třikrát jinak
description: The Chlum Three Ways race is the fourth event in the Rozhledny v pohybu series, held near Plzeň. Competitors tackle the prominent Chlum summit in three ways: a mass-start uphill race, an interval hill run, and a stair climb to the observation tower. The overall standings are based on the combined times from all three events, with bonuses for the top three finishers. Children can compete in ten age categories on courses around the observation tower. A relay is also available, with teams of three runners completing all three disciplines.

name: Třanovická 10
description: Třanovická 10 is a traditional running race held in the village of Třanovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The routes run along clay-gravel, forest, field and asphalt roads within the cadastral areas of Třanovice and Dolní Domaslavice. The event is open to the general public and includes a 10 km main race, a 5 km race and a relay. The start and finish are by the municipal office, and the race begins at 9:00. Registration is available online and on-site, with race bibs and medals available for collection by those who register early.

name: DEVIL’S CHALLENGE – ČERTOVSKÁ VÝZVA – 666km aneb superantikontramultiextraunikátní běžecký závod
description: Čertovská výzva 666 km is an 8-day stage running race through the beautiful countryside of northern Bohemia. It offers a 666 km route or a shortened 4-stage option. The race passes through Kokořínsko, the Máchův kraj region, the Lusatian Mountains, the Ještěd Ridge and Bohemian Paradise. The final stage follows the same course as the Čertovský ultratrail 66.6 km. The race is open to individuals, pairs and teams of three, with the option to take turns running the stages. Individual stages can also be selected. The start and finish are in Hamr na Jezeře, with group transfers to the stage starts and GPS navigation. The entry fee includes a pre-race buffet.

name: 1/2Maraton Bělský les
description: The Bělský les Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque setting of Bělský les in Ostrava-Zábřeh. It offers several distances, including a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 4 × 5 km relay, and the Nachmelená 25 km hiking event. The race is suitable for both competitive runners and the general public, and supports charitable causes. The start and finish are at Vodní areál Jih, providing a pleasant atmosphere and good facilities for participants.

name: Běh pro Paměť Národa – Ostrava
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Ostrava is a charity sports and community event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of witnesses and helps them. The race takes place on May 30, 2026, in Komenského sady, with timed 4 km (1 lap) and 8 km (2 laps) races. The event is open to all age groups, including children’s races, and offers the option of a symbolic run anywhere. The start and finish are by the statue of J. A. Comenius, with refreshments and restroom facilities available for participants.

name: Běh přes tři vsi
description: Běh přes tři vsi is a modern cross-country race that continues the tradition of a road race organized by Spartak Sedlec. The race is intended both for athletes and for runners who want to enjoy the beauty of the countryside. The youngest runners are not forgotten either, as running can bring them lifelong joy. The route passes through three villages—Sedlec, Lhůta, and Tymákov—in the area around Starý Plzenec.

name: Chlum třikrát jinak
description: Chlum Three Ways is a hill race to Chlum, a prominent peak near Plzeň, tackled in three different ways. It starts with a mass-start uphill race over 1.75 km. The event is appealing to runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain and wanting to try different routes up the same hill. It is part of the running community and offers an enjoyable experience in nature close to Plzeň.

name: Běh na Děvín
description: Běh na Děvín is an uphill running race offering two distances: 4.4 km and 9.1 km. The route runs mostly over trails and finishes at the summit of Děvín, offering beautiful views and a challenging profile. The race is part of the Czech Cup in Uphill Running and is suitable for runners seeking a challenge in the natural surroundings of the South Moravian Region. The start is by the church in Perná and the finish is at the summit of Děvín, guaranteeing a unique mountain running experience.

name: Běžecké závody AC Praha 1890
description: The AC Praha 1890 Praha–Brandýs races are traditional race-walking events with a history dating back to 1892. The race takes place in Arborka Forest Park in Prague 14 and offers courses for men, women, juniors, and children. The course is a paved circuit suitable for fast running and walking. The race is part of the men’s and women’s leagues and is open to both amateur and club athletes. Race numbers and chips are issued at registration; timing is provided by chips and a finish-line camera.

name: Čertovská výzva - jednotlivé etapy
description: Čertovská výzva is a unique 8-day, 666 km stage running race through the beautiful countryside of northern Bohemia. Shorter options are also available: a 4-stage race or individual stages. The route passes through Kokořínsko, Máchův kraj, the Lužické Mountains, the Ještěd Ridge and Český ráj. The final stage follows the same course as the 66.6 km Čertovský ultratrail. The race is open to individuals, pairs and teams of three, with the option to take turns. Chip timing and a GPS tracker are provided. The start and finish are in Hamr na Jezeře, with group transfers available to the stage starts. The entry fee includes a pre-race buffet.

name: WEBER Jičínská10 (CityRun Jičín)
description: Jičínská 10 is a traditional running race held in the picturesque town of Jičín. The race offers a 10 km course suitable for the general public and runners of all levels. The event takes place on Saturday, May 30, 2026, and includes a training run on the course to help participants prepare. The atmosphere is friendly, welcoming all runners who want to take on a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.

name: Nekořský kros
description: Nekoř Cross-Country Race is a traditional running race held in Nekoř, Pardubice Region, and is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The routes follow varied terrain along forest paths and meadows, with some sections on asphalt, making for an interesting and varied running experience. The start and finish are by the ice rink in Nekoř, where registration also takes place. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners, including young people, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and practical prizes for winners in the individual categories.

name: Běh mezi náměstími
description: Běh mezi náměstími is a traditional running race held at Svobody Square in Frýdek-Místek, attracting a wide range of participants, from children to adults. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere, beautiful weather, and the chance to compete on a course that runs to Zámecké Square and back. Special races are prepared for children, with medals, prizes, and refreshments, while adults run the main course, approximately 4.7 km long. Winners and all participants take home not only prizes, but also the joy of exercise and socializing.

name: Chodsko Grand Prix
description: Chodsko Grand Prix is a 9.6 km race with 130 meters of elevation gain, running mostly on roads from the village of Klenčí pod Čerchovem to Hrádek Hill. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska competition and offers runners an interesting route with a gentle climb. It is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in the picturesque Plzeň Region.

name: Festivalový půlmaraton MONET+ Zlín 2026
description: The MONET+ Zlín Festival Half Marathon 2026 is a 21.097 km road race open to the public, with no club membership required. The race takes place on the streets of Zlín, starting near the Zlín Congress Centre, and also offers other options, including a quarter marathon, relays and a 5 km run. The programme also includes a 1,400-metre Family Run. Part of Zlín’s festival programme, the event offers a unique atmosphere and the chance to run alongside well-known personalities.

name: Zahořanská 10 (Běh okolo Pleše)
description: BOS Zahořanská 10 is a traditional running race organized by SK Zahořany under the auspices of the municipality of Zahořany. The eighth edition will take place on May 31, 2026, and features a 10.2 km main race for men and women with 250 m of elevation gain on forest trails around Zahořany and Pleš. There is also a 5.5 km fun run and children’s races of various distances. Timing and results are provided by the 4Timing agency using chip technology. Registration is available online and on site, with different price categories for adults, juniors, and children.

name: Maraton a půlmaraton okolo Hracholuské přehrady
description: The Marathon and Half Marathon around Hracholusky Reservoir is a race held on May 31, 2026, offering a beautiful natural loop around the reservoir. The route runs mostly on paved paths along the water, with a few short sections of natural terrain, giving it a slightly trail-like feel without unnecessary difficulty. A standout experience is crossing the Pňovany Bridge, with breathtaking views of the reservoir and surrounding landscape. The race loop is 21.1 km long—the exact half-marathon distance—and is suitable for runners seeking a combination of beautiful scenery, a motivating atmosphere, and a pleasant course profile.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Lesná
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beautiful Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in various locations, including Lesná, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km, an adventure route covers 20 to 30 km, and children’s races are also held. The routes are suitable for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers, offering a varied sporting challenge for all age groups. The series is organized by Živé Sokolovsko z.s. and Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s. in cooperation with local municipalities.

name: Mezinárodní běh Měška a Doubravky
description: The International Měšek and Doubravka Run is a summer race for adults covering 12.5 km. It starts in Mirošov and finishes at AQA Land swimming pool in Meziměstí. The race is part of the East Bohemia Grand Prix and follows the picturesque landscape of the Polish-Czech border region, through meadows and forests. The start is at the amphitheatre on Parkowa Hill at 11:00; the finish and awards ceremony take place at the swimming pool. Free bus transport from Meziměstí to Mieroszów is provided for Czech competitors. Registration is free and available online or at the venue on race day.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Zadní Třebaň
description: The Berounka Running Series in Zadní Třebaň is a scenic race held amid the beautiful countryside of the Central Bohemian Region. The route follows the Berounka River, crosses meadows with panoramic views, passes the Liteň nature trail, and winds through picturesque countryside reminiscent of Tuscany. The race culminates with a climb to the course’s highest point in Doubce, followed by a final descent to the finish at a pleasant campsite with refreshments. Every participant receives a race number, and the top three in each category receive diplomas and medals.

name: Běh Advenťáka PLZEŇ
description: Běh Advenťáka Plzeň 2026 is a charity run held in support of people who are facing difficulties in life. The race takes place on June 2, 2026, at the Krašovské Activity Center and offers a 6.45 km course along paved paths around Krkavec. Children’s categories with shorter courses are also available. Participants receive a race bib, a certificate with their time, a gingerbread cookie, and other gifts. Part of the entry fee goes to support heroes.

name: Krčská 12
description: Krčská 12 is a traditional running race organized by the Sabzo Praha running club in Krčský Forest. The race is run on asphalt and features a 12.5 km course consisting of four loops. The start is at the Great Gazebo in Kunratice, usually in the early evening. The event is part of the regular sports and entertainment program in Nové Roztyly Park, which is also suitable for families with children.

name: Běh Advenťáka Praha
description: Běh Advenťáka Prague 2026 is a charity running race taking place on June 3 in Hvězda Game Reserve in Prague. The race offers a 6.45 km course on paved paths, suitable for trail shoes, as well as children’s categories with shorter courses. The event combines the joy of running with support for people facing difficulties in life, and participants contribute to a good cause. It also includes activities for children and facilities with refreshments and a cloakroom. The race is part of the Běh Advenťáka series, held in several cities.

name: Štafeta 4 × 5 km v Braníku 2026
description: The 4 × 5 km Relay in Braník is a team running race taking place on June 3, 2026, on the cycle path in Braník, Prague. The race is for teams of four runners, each of whom runs a 5 km loop. The event offers a chance to enjoy a team atmosphere, cheer each other on, and celebrate after the race at the Hamr Braník venue. The course follows cycle path A2 along the Vltava and is suitable for a wide range of runners, with a time limit of 2 hours and 20 minutes for the entire race.

name: Okolo Peperku
location: Najdek, Hamry. Za mostkem u hřiště, Vysočina
description: Žďárák - Around Peperk is a cross-country race with mostly off-road terrain, held in the picturesque Vysočina region in the village of Najdek, Hamry. The 7 km course consists of 85% trails and 15% asphalt, with 180 metres of elevation gain, making for an interesting and challenging route. The race starts on 3 June 2026 at 17:00 by the small bridge near the sports field and is organised by SK Žďárák. This race is ideal for trail-running enthusiasts looking for a challenge in nature.

name: Pohár města Třemošnice
description: The O pohár starosty města Třemošnice fire sport competition is a traditional sporting event held in Třemošnice and is part of the Chrudim District League. Men’s and women’s teams compete, showcasing top-level performances in fire sport. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, high-quality organization, and plentiful refreshments for participants and fans. It is organized by the Třemošnice Volunteer Fire Brigade in cooperation with the town of Třemošnice. Everyone is welcome to the next edition, which will take place on June 3, 2026.

name: 3. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park Boženy Němcové, Karviná, Czech Republic
description: Běh pro zdraví is a charitable running series organized by the TJ Jäkl Karviná athletics club in the beautiful setting of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run is 3 km long and is suitable for anyone who wants to do something for their health while supporting people in need, as the proceeds from entry fees are donated to help those in need. The event is friendly and open to the general public, with participants free to run at any pace. Registration begins at 17:00 and the start is at 17:45. Everyone is warmly invited to take part in this regular sporting event.
course_highlights: A 3 km route in the beautiful setting of Božena Němcová Park
The route follows a cycle path suitable for running
A charity run with proceeds going to help people in need
additional: Registration begins at 17:00, with the start at 17:45 at Lodičky in Božena Němcová Park. A series of seven runs for health, where everyone can run the route at any pace. Charity run; proceeds from entry fees go to help people in need.

name: Běh na Vysoký vrch
description: The Run to Vysoký vrch is a mountain race to the highest hill in the Kladno region. It offers a challenging but short run, with 200 metres of elevation gain over a route approximately 2.8 km long. The race is divided into age and gender categories, allowing for fair competition. The event takes place in Malé Kyšice and is organised by TJ Sokol Unhošť. The race is scheduled to start in the afternoon, creating a pleasant atmosphere for both runners and spectators.

name: Rozkvetlá Kaštanka
description: Rozkvetlá Kaštanka is a popular running race held in Lhota, Central Bohemian Region, traditionally in June. The race features a 7.5 km route along paved roads and is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup. Participants can enjoy beautiful natural scenery and the atmosphere of spring, when the surrounding area bursts into bloom with gorgeous chestnut blossoms. The race is suitable for runners of all abilities and is a welcome opportunity to meet the local running community.

name: Kolem Trpaslíka v Hybrálci
description: The Kolem Trpaslíka race in Hybrálec is a 10 km running race that runs mostly along unpaved forest paths in the Hybrálec area near Jihlava. The race is part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup and offers runners the opportunity to enjoy the natural terrain of the Vysočina region. The course is suitable for fans of forest running and a pleasant sporting experience in nature.

name: Valašské kilo
description: Valašské Kilo is a challenging 100 km ultramarathon through the beautiful, hilly landscape of Valašsko, with at least 3,500 metres of elevation gain. The race challenges not only experienced athletes but also those who want to push their limits and experience an off-road adventure. After the mass start at 22:00, runners plan their own routes between checkpoints within the 30-hour time limit. Race headquarters are at Žerotínova Elementary School in Valašské Meziříčí, where a gym, showers and a dining hall are available. Valašské Kilo offers the freedom to navigate the terrain and is one of the best ultramarathons in Czechia.

name: Čertovskej Trail

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné stejné pro obě trasy: 1 222 Kč

description: Čertovskej Ultratrail is a challenging trail run through the mountains, valleys, castles and waters of the mysterious Kokořínsko and Máchův kraj regions. It offers a main 66.6 km route that is also suitable for beginner ultrarunners thanks to well-stocked aid stations and a friendly atmosphere. A shorter 33.3 km course, called Letní půlčert, is also available. The race is part of the prestigious Ultracup series and offers ITRA points to runners. Capacity is limited, so early registration is recommended.
course_highlights: A trail run through the mountains, valleys, castles and waters of Kokořínsko and Máchův kraj
Well-stocked aid stations along the course
Scenic countryside and a family-friendly race atmosphere
additional: A personal drinking cup is mandatory equipment. You can order one during registration, along with a Čertovskej cup, T-shirt or socks. Race capacity is limited. Categories are available for individuals and relay teams, including a family relay with a child under 15. The route is marked with ribbons and arrows. The time limit for the Čertovskej Wintertrail is 7 hours. Post-race refreshments are provided at the finish, including soup, a main course and drinks. The race is part of the UTMB Index Races and ITRA National League. A personal cup is mandatory at the aid stations. A running cup, T-shirt or socks can be ordered during registration.

name: Jesenická šedesátka
description: Jesenická šedesátka is a hiking and running event along the ridges of the Hrubý Jeseník Mountains, offering beautiful natural surroundings and the chance to test yourself against the clock. The 60 km route is intended for more experienced participants aged 16 and over and includes refreshment stations. The event is a long-standing favourite, with chip timing and results announced at the finish. The organizers emphasize safety and a relaxed atmosphere, and the event is suitable for both runners and hikers.

name: Čertovskej ultratrail
description: Čertovskej Ultraltrail is a trail race across mountains, mines, castles and waters through the mysterious countryside of Kokořínsko and the Máchův kraj region. It offers a main 66.6 km route through beautiful scenery, with well-stocked aid stations, and is suitable for beginner ultrarunners too. The race is part of the Ultracup series and is also the final stage of the 8-day Čertovská výzva 666 km. The atmosphere is family-friendly, and runners will enjoy unforgettable experiences on the picturesque course.

name: Skřipovská lítačka
description: Skřipovská lítačka is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of fields, meadows, and forests around the village of Skřipov near Opava. The seventh edition will take place on June 6, 2026, with its hub at the TJ Sokol Skřipov football field. The race offers courses for all age groups, from the youngest children to adults, along with a varied accompanying program including an inflatable maze, face painting, and refreshments. All courses are clearly marked, and volunteers at intersections point runners in the right direction. The event is organized by Běžecký klub Skřipov, z. s.

name: Happy run
description: Happy Run is a charity run held on June 6, 2026, in Studenec u Třebíče in the Vysočina Region. It is open to everyone—athletes and non-athletes, families with children, and individuals—with several routes to choose from to suit their abilities. The event supports Viktorka, a boy with serious health complications, and the proceeds from the run will go toward his rehabilitation stay. In addition to the run itself, there will be a varied programme of activities and an evening social party.

name: Běh napříč republikou
location: Česko (867 km po celé republice), Vysočina
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event, now taking place for the fifth year. Participants run together from different parts of the Czech Republic to its geographical center in Čihošť, at a pace suited to recreational runners and comfortable for conversation. The routes are divided into individual sections, with pacers who help maintain the right pace and follow the route. This is not a race, but a shared experience that offers a chance to discover new places and meet other runners.

name: Z Hejnic do Pekla
description: Z Hejnic do Pekla 2026 is the second edition of a running race held in the Liberec Region, starting at the Hejnice Skatepark. The race offers a welcoming atmosphere, refreshments, medical support, and a race packet for every participant. It is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and seniors, who receive special entry fee conditions. The organizers prioritize runners’ comfort, providing changing rooms, showers, and luggage storage.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S01 – Machnín-Výpřež
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique event that is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace. In 2026, it will take place for the fifth time, with four parallel routes heading from different parts of the Czech Republic (including a route from Liberec-Machnín) to the country’s geographical center in Čihošť. The run follows a precise schedule, with pacers on every section to set the pace and guide the route. Participants can choose how many sections they want to run, and stop at interesting places along the way to enjoy the beauty of the landscape.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S02 – Výpřež-Rašovka
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event taking place for the fifth time. It brings together four starts from different corners of the Czech Republic, all heading to the country’s geographical center in Čihošť. It is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace, with pacers on each section responsible for the pace and route guidance. Participants can choose any number of sections to run, and stop at interesting places along the way to enjoy the beauty of the landscape. The event is suitable for recreational runners and offers a chance to discover new places and meet like-minded people.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S03 – Rašovka-Hodkovice nad Mohelkou
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event that brings runners from different parts of the Czech Republic together at a shared destination in Čihošť, the geographical centre of the Czech Republic. It is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace, with pacers on every leg to set the pace and guide the route. Participants can choose any number of legs from a total of 82 carefully designed routes, which cross varied terrain, from hills to flatlands, forests and towns. The run offers a chance to discover new places, meet like-minded runners and enjoy an unusual sporting experience.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S04 – Hodkovice nad Mohelkou-Frýdštejn
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique event that brings runners from different parts of the Czech Republic together at a shared destination in Čihošť, the geographical center of the country. It is not a race, but a group run with pacers who maintain a conversational pace and provide route guidance. Participants can choose any number of sections from a total of 82 carefully designed segments, which cover varied terrain, from hills and flatlands to forests and towns. The event is suitable for recreational runners who want to discover new places, meet new people, and enjoy an unusual running experience.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S05 – Frýdštejn-Turnov
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event that brings runners from different parts of the Czech Republic together at a shared destination in Čihošť, the geographical center of the Czech Republic. It is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace, with pacers on individual sections. Runners can choose any number of sections from a total of 82 carefully designed routes, which cross varied terrain, from hills and flatlands to forests and towns. The aim is not only to be physically active, but also to discover new places and meet like-minded people.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S06 – Turnov-Vyskeř
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event that brings runners from different parts of the Czech Republic together at a shared destination in Čihošť, the geographical centre of the country. It is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace, with pace leaders on each section. The routes pass through beautiful countryside, forests, towns and hills, and participants can choose any number of sections to run. The event offers a chance to discover new places, meet like-minded runners and enjoy an unusual sporting experience. The start is on Saturday, June 6, 2026, at 7:00 a.m., and the finish is in Čihošť on Sunday, June 7, at 5:00 p.m.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S07 – Vyskeř-Podkost
description: Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event that brings runners from different parts of the Czech Republic together at a shared destination in Čihošť, the geographical centre of the country. It is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace, with pacers on each section. Runners can choose any number of sections and experience the beauty of the Czech countryside, whether in the hills, on flat terrain, along forest trails or on city streets. The event starts at 7:00 on 6 June 2026 from four locations and finishes in Čihošť at 17:00 on 7 June.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S08 – Podkost-Dolní Bousov
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event that brings runners from different parts of the Czech Republic together at a shared destination in Čihošť, the geographical center of the country. It is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace, with pace leaders on individual sections. Runners can choose any number of sections and join the running “trains” from Liberec, Pohoří na Šumavě, Prostějov, and Rokycany. The route crosses varied terrain—hills, flat stretches, forests, and towns—and offers the chance to discover new places and meet like-minded people.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S09 – Dolní Bousov-Domousnice
description: Run Across the Republic is a unique event that brings runners from different parts of the Czech Republic together at a shared destination in Čihošť, the country’s geographical center. It is not a race, but a group run with pacers who maintain a conversational pace and guide runners along the route. The routes are divided into sections, which participants can choose freely and run as many of as they like. The event offers a chance to discover new places, meet new friends, and enjoy the beauty of the Czech countryside across varied terrain.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S10 – Domousnice-Ledce
description: The Run Across the Republic is a unique relay event that brings runners from different parts of the Czech Republic together at a shared finish in Čihošť, the geographical center of the country. It is not a race, but a group run at a conversational pace, with pacers on each section. Runners can choose any number of sections and join the running “trains” from Liberec, Pohoří na Šumavě, Prostějov, and Rokycany. The route crosses varied terrain—hills, flat stretches, forests, and towns—and offers the chance to discover new places and meet like-minded people.

name: Běh napříč republikou, S11 – Ledce-Loučeň
description: Run Across the Republic, S11 - Ledce-Loučeň is a planned running race taking place on June 6, 2026, in the area around Ledce and Loučeň in the Central Bohemian Region. Exact details about the course, distance, or registration are not available in the sources, but the race is part of a broader concept of running or hiking events in the Czech Republic. It offers runners and hikers an opportunity to discover the region’s beauty and enjoy active recreation outdoors.

name: Běh na Kohout a zpět
description: Běh na Kohout is a traditional uphill race that has been held since 2006 in Besednice, by the swimming pool. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup, and most editions follow the same course, making it possible to compare times. The start and finish are at the swimming pool in Besednice, which offers excellent facilities. Each year, there is an accompanying programme and a raffle with attractive prizes. The race will take place on Saturday, June 6, 2026, and welcomes runners in all categories.

name: Barvám Neutečeš Ústí nad Labem
description: Barvám Neutečeš in Ústí nad Labem is a colorful run full of joy, friendship, and fun, taking place on June 6, 2026, in the Severní Terasa district. Participants can choose between a 5 km route with five color zones or a shorter 1.5 km route with three color zones and an interactive sports zone. It’s not about speed, but about sharing the experience, enjoying bursts of color, and soaking up a great atmosphere for all ages. Race packs include a T-shirt, colors, a medal, and other accessories that add to the event’s unique character. Come with family or friends, or on your own, and enjoy a day full of color and fun.

name: Běh na Čerchov
description: The Run to Čerchov is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Klenčí pod Čerchovem. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska series, which offers runners a range of routes around the Chodsko region. It is suitable for all running enthusiasts looking to experience a challenging yet beautiful run in nature, with views of Čerchov. The organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Běh okolo Hostěnic
description: The Run Around Hostěnice is a running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Hostěnice. It offers a flat 5.83 km course combining paved and forest paths. The race takes place on Saturday, June 6, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. and is suitable for the general public, including children, who have a shorter course tailored to their age. Organizers David Šálek and Jan Řebíček warmly invite all runners to take part in this traditional event.

name: 5, 10, 21 km trail okolo hory pro každého
description: The Trail Running Cup is a traditional series of trail races with a history dating back to 2011, offering courses of various distances from 5 to 50 kilometers amid the beautiful scenery of the Czech Republic. The races are suitable for all runners, including children, and provide great entertainment for the whole family. The series features a variety of terrain and difficulty levels, so everyone can find a course to suit them. The overall standings are based on points awarded for results in individual races held throughout the season.

name: Běh dobroučským krajem
description: The Běh dobroučským krajem is a traditional running race organized by the ISCAREX Athletics Club in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Dobrouč in the Pardubice Region. The race offers technically interesting courses with gentle undulations and a number of turns, running along paved paths. The event is open to the general public and welcomes experienced runners, recreational athletes, and families with children. It is part of the regional ISCAREX Cup running series and offers a great sporting atmosphere and facilities for runners and spectators alike.

name: Běháme pro radost - Help4Africa
description: Běháme pro radost is a traditional charity run held in the village of Smidary, celebrating its 10th edition in 2026. The event supports children’s projects in Africa through the organization Help4Africa, founded by Marcel Doubrava. The run combines physical activity with helping children in need, and participants can see the direct impact of their support through photographs from the projects. It is not only a sporting event, but also an opportunity to find joy in helping others.

name: Kounovský kros
description: Kounovský kros is a running race organized by TriClub Dobruška, held in the picturesque surroundings of Kounov near Dobruška in the Hradec Králové Region. The race is part of the Dobruška Cup and offers a sporting experience for the general public, including amateur runners. TriClub Dobruška is known for its long-standing tradition and for actively involving its members and the public in sporting events. The race is suitable for all age groups and levels of running ability.

name: Řepočetův výběh
description: Řepočetův výběh is a unique sporting and social event in Rokytnice nad Jizerou, taking place on June 6, 2026, at the open-air theatre grounds in Horní Rokytnice. The race offers two routes: 19.1 km with 650 m of elevation gain for Řepáci and 12 km with 400 m of elevation gain for Dumliky. The event supports the Run for the Memory of the Nation initiative and offers original race bibs, with the option to donate to the nonprofit organization Post Bellum. The race starts at 14:00, registration opens at 12:00, refreshments will be provided after the race, and the venue is accessible only on foot, with parking available within walking distance.

name: Mnichovohradištská patnáctka, memoriál ing. Josefa Hrona
description: The Mnichovohradištská Fifteen is a road race with a gently undulating out-and-back course measuring 15 km. It takes place in Mnichovo Hradiště, on T. G. Masaryk Square. The course is well paved and has marked kilometres, helping runners pace themselves. The race is held in memory of Ing. Josef Hron and offers a pleasant atmosphere for all runners. The start is at 10:00, and the organiser is Vladimír Koudelka. The race is suitable for runners looking for a quality road run with a long tradition.

name: Běh 2 míle Olomouc
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all age groups. Each participant competes primarily against themselves, creating a friendly and motivating atmosphere. The race takes place in the beautiful setting of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, adding to the enjoyment of the run. It is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners looking to test their speed over a short distance.

name: Běh přes Červený vrch
description: The Run over Červený vrch is a traditional running race organized by Atletický klub ISCAREX in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Čermná in the Pardubice Region. The race features a technically engaging course with gentle undulations and plenty of turns, suitable for a wide range of runners, from recreational athletes to experienced competitors. The event is part of the regional ISCAREX Cup running series and provides quality facilities for both runners and spectators. You can register online or on site on race day, June 7, 2026.

name: Babický trail 1/4 maraton 2026
description: The Babice Trail Quarter Marathon is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Babice Forest. The event offers two main routes, 10.55 km and 5.95 km long, which run mostly along forest roads and trails with a gentle elevation gain. Children’s categories with shorter distances are also available. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and emphasizes a community atmosphere and the joy of exercising in nature. The main race is limited to 200 participants, so early registration is recommended.

name: Skalecký kros
description: Skalecký Cross-Country Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque Baroque grounds of Skalka in Mníšek pod Brdy. It offers 10 km and 5 km courses, as well as children’s races, running along forest paths and paved roads. The main race starts at 11:30 and is suitable for the general public, including children and teenagers. The event is organized by SK Mníšecko, z.s., which ensures high-quality organization and a welcoming atmosphere.

name: Červenkovská desítka
description: Červenkovská Desítka is a 10 km road race held in Červenka near Olomouc. The race is part of the 2026 Haná Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners. The course is an out-and-back route from Červenka through Dětřichov to Renoty and back, mostly on roads. Runners are divided into age categories, with prizes awarded to the winners in each category. The results ceremony will take place at the race venue, Hostinec u Nádraží, and the results will be published on hanackybeh.cz.

name: Milada Run
description: Milada Run is a popular sporting event held in the unique landscape of a former brown-coal mine, transformed into the beautiful natural surroundings of Lake Milada. The event offers various routes, including a half marathon, 10 km race, and children’s races, which follow undulating and flat paths with views of the lake. The atmosphere is family-friendly and welcoming, making it suitable for all ages and running abilities. All races are part of the Milada Tour series, which runners themselves praise for its high standards and popularity.

name: Konopišťská desítka
description: The Konopiště 10K is a traditional 10 km running race held in the beautiful natural amphitheatre and park at Konopiště near Benešov. The race is part of the Benešov Running Festival and offers the chance to compete in the main race, relays, and children’s categories. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to enjoy a run in picturesque countryside with high-quality organisation. The 30th anniversary edition will take place on 7 June 2026.

name: Bolfánek třikrát jinak
description: Bolfánek Three Ways is a running race organized by Pro Sport Activities in Chudenice, in the Plzeň Region. The race is part of the Rozhledny v pohybu series and offers an unusual format in which runners tackle the course in three different ways. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own age categories. The organizers emphasize a sporting experience in beautiful natural surroundings and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Mnichovická běhna
description: The Mnichovická běhna is an amateur running race through the beautiful Central Bohemian countryside, featuring a challenging course approximately 7–8 km long with around 200 meters of elevation gain. The varied terrain includes steep climbs and descents, running on paved paths, through forest, meadow, and pasture, accompanied by domestic and forest animals. The start and finish have been newly located at the Podhorky playing field by the Šibeniční vrch sports complex. All runners receive a commemorative medal and certificate; category winners receive trophies and a small surprise. The Mnichovická běhna is part of the Ladův kraj Cup running race series, and everyone who finishes the race healthy and alive is a winner.

name: Babický Trail 1/4 maraton
description: The Babice Trail Quarter Marathon is a traditional running race held in the beautiful Babice Forest near Říčany. It offers two main routes, 10.55 km and 5.95 km long, with elevation gains of 160 m and 60 m respectively, running mostly along forest roads and trails. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own shorter courses. The event has a strong community focus, and the organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and support for the running community in Babice.

name: Mladé BĚKODO
description: Mladé Běkodo is a series of running races for children and young people aged 2 to 15, held around Doubravka in Teplice. The races offer distances from 200 to 1,650 metres and are divided into age categories. Each race is followed by an awards ceremony for individual and team results. BK Běkodo is part of TJ Lokomotiva Teplice and has a long tradition dating back to 2001.

name: Běh Advenťáka BRNO
description: Běh Advenťáka Brno 2026 is a charity race held on June 9 by the Medlánky Pond in Brno. The race offers a 6.45 km course on paved paths, suitable for runners of all levels, with trail shoes recommended. The event also includes children’s categories with shorter courses. Participants’ entry fees support people who face challenges in life, and runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere, sports prizes, and other benefits.

name: Pivní míle Heřmanův Městec
description: The Beer Mile in Heřmanův Městec is an original race on the Bažantnice athletics track, where runners complete four laps of 400 metres with beer breaks. This unconventional sporting experience combines running and fun in a friendly atmosphere. This year marks the 10th edition of this popular event, which is part of the Heřmanův Městec running club.

name: Otevřený přebor SABZO v přespolním běhu
description: The SABZO Open Cross-Country Championship is a traditional running race organized by the SABZO Running Club in Prague. The race gives amateur runners the chance to test their strength in cross-country running in a pleasant sporting atmosphere. The SABZO Club is known for its long history and for regularly organizing running events in Prague and the surrounding area. The race is part of the club’s broader calendar of running events, which promotes an active lifestyle and a community of runners.

name: Běh Advenťáka OSTRAVA
description: The Advenťák Ostrava Run 2026 is a charity running race held on June 10 in Komenského sady. The race offers two main categories: adults running 6.45 km and children, called little elves, on courses from 0.2 to 1 km. The route follows paved and firm-surface paths, and road-running shoes are recommended. A large portion of the entry fee supports heroes who face challenges in life, and participants receive a race number, certificate, gingerbread cookie, and other benefits. The event is friendly, charitable, and suitable for all age groups.

name: Trail Zlíchovskými vyhlídkami VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
description: The VAŠÍ LIGA Trail of Zlíchov Viewpoints is an amateur trail race held in Prague, offering runners the experience of running in nature across varied terrain and enjoying interesting views. The races are part of VAŠÍ LIGA, the largest amateur league in the Czech Republic, which promotes the joy of sport and a community atmosphere. Participants can look forward to a friendly environment and the chance to test themselves against runners of all ages. Winners are regularly announced and awarded medals in the under-40 and 40+ categories.

name: Červnová Krásná Morava
description: The June Krásná Morava is a running race organized by the Central Moravian Association of Endurance Sports in Olomouc-Hejčín. It is part of the rich tradition of running events in the Olomouc Region, which are open to runners of all ages and abilities. The race offers a chance to experience the picturesque Haná countryside and join a community of sports enthusiasts. STMSVS is known for its long-standing organization of endurance sports and its support for running, cycling, and triathlon disciplines in the region.

name: Přes tři hráze Opatov
description: Přes tři hráze Opatov is a traditional running race held in Opatov in the Vysočina Region and is part of the Vysočina Runner’s Cup series. The race offers various distances, including the 8.8 km main course for men and veterans up to 69 years old, as well as shorter courses for women, veterans over 70, juniors, youth, and children. The course runs mainly along field and forest paths, including a route over the dams of three local ponds, giving the race its unique character. The event is open to a broad range of age groups and emphasizes sporting experiences and support for the local running community.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton Olomouc 2026
description: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc 2026 is a traditional half marathon that takes you through the beauty of Olomouc’s historic center. The start and finish are on Upper Square, where you can admire the Holy Trinity Column and the town hall with its unique astronomical clock. During the race, you’ll enjoy the city’s atmosphere, historic buildings, and beautiful parks. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and also offers an accompanying program.

name: Horem dolem Chospílem
description: Horem dolem Chospílem is a 9.2 km interval-start running race that follows meadows and farm tracks around Postřekov in the Chospíl area. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska series and offers runners pleasant terrain in a natural setting. The interval start makes for an interesting race format. This race is suitable for runners looking for a mix of nature and sporting challenge in the Plzeň Region.

name: Sokolovský  ¼ maraton
organizer: Živý kraj – Destinační agentura pro Karlovarský kraj, z.s.
description: The Sokolov Quarter Marathon is a running event taking place on June 13, 2026, in Sokolov in the Karlovy Vary Region. The course runs mainly through scenic parts of the city and the surrounding countryside, and is approximately 10.5 km long. The event is intended both for recreational runners and for those who want to experience the atmosphere of a race in beautiful surroundings. The organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and a sporting experience for all participants.

name: Dobročinný běh po stopách Silver A
description: We invite you to the 3rd annual charity run and walk, In the Footsteps of Silver A, organized by the Zámeček Memorial in Pardubice. The event is suitable for athletes and non-athletes, children and adults, and the entry fees go to charitable causes. The run offers two routes—a shorter 5-kilometer route and a longer 10-kilometer route—as well as a children’s race of approximately 1 kilometer. There will also be a guided walk through the city to places associated with the Silver A parachute group, starting at the Zámeček Memorial.

name: Hradecký koloběh
description: Hradecký Koloběh is a mixed-pair race held in the beautiful surroundings of the city forests, starting at Biřička. The race combines running and cycling: one team member runs while the other rides a bike. Competitors can switch at any time during the race, adding strategy and excitement. The event celebrates team spirit and the joy of movement, with OPEN and FAMILY categories. It is held with the support of the City of Hradec Králové and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Jinecký kros
organizer: Městys Jince a Jinečáček, z. s.
description: Jinecký kros is a traditional running race held in Jince, offering a challenging course approximately 5.7 km long with around 178 metres of elevation gain. The start and finish are at the football pitch by the Biokoupaliště, which provides facilities for runners, including parking, changing rooms, showers and refreshments. The course runs along asphalt roads, forest paths and meadows, and includes crossing a wooden footbridge, running on asphalt roads and climbing Vystrkov hill. The race is suitable for adults and children, who have their own categories. The main race starts at 11:00.

name: Jindřichohradecký půlmaraton
description: The Jindřichův Hradec Half Marathon 2026 is the tenth anniversary edition of a running race offering a unique experience that combines the town’s picturesque historic centre, sections along the water, and natural stretches with significant elevation gain. The race is open to individuals running 21.1 km, as well as relay teams, families, and schools taking part in shorter races. The atmosphere is enhanced by fans and music, with race services including refreshment stations and showers. A special Rebel Run is also planned for schools, focusing on teamwork rather than time. The race starts on 13 June 2026. Participants will receive original medals and can win prizes.

name: Neveklovské běhy
organizer: kulturní a sportovní komise města Neveklov
description: Neveklov Runs is a traditional running event held in the picturesque Castle Park in Neveklov. The race offers runners of all abilities the chance to enjoy a run in the park’s pleasant surroundings and friendly atmosphere. The event is part of the wider Běžec Podblanicka running race calendar, which promotes an active lifestyle and brings athletes in the region together.

name: 7 pohoří Jeseníky
description: Jeseníky 2026 is a technical trail race in the beautiful countryside beneath Králický Sněžník, offering three courses of varying distances and elevation gain. The routes have been prepared by members of the local mountain rescue service and run mostly through natural terrain. Participants can enjoy a professionally marked course, chip timing, refreshments along the route and at the finish, and a commemorative medal. The event takes place in all weather conditions and is suitable for all trail-running enthusiasts looking for epic views and an atmosphere they won’t find anywhere else.

name: Okrouhelský běh
description: The Okrouhlá Run is a traditional race in the Českolipsko District Running League, held in the picturesque village of Okrouhlá in the Liberec Region. The race offers runners of all levels the chance to enjoy a run in a natural setting with a friendly atmosphere. The Okrouhlá Run is part of a series of regional running races that promote an active lifestyle and community sports.

name: Extrem Run 5Hills
description: Extrem Run 5 Hills is an ultratrail running race in the westernmost part of the Czech Republic, offering a challenging 91-kilometre course with 2,174 metres of elevation gain. The route crosses five peaks of Egerland and combines paved roads, cycling and hiking trails, and forest terrain. The race is intended for experienced runners seeking an extreme sporting challenge and stunning panoramas. The organizers place emphasis on accurate timekeeping and participant safety. The race takes place in the scenic Vojtanov area and also offers relay and two-person duathlon options.

name: Běh na Pajrek
description: Běh na Pajrek is the second edition of a running race organized by TJ Nýrsko, taking place on June 13, 2026, at the venue below the ski slope in Nýrsko. The race offers men an 8.6 km course (2 laps) and women a 4.2 km course (1 lap), with 152 meters of elevation gain per lap. The finish is at the same location as the start. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Ešus League, with refreshments available at the venue. The organizers note that the course may change due to construction work and provide prizes in kind for the top finishers in each category.

name: Běh zámeckým parkem Kravaře
description: The Run Through Kravaře Chateau Park is a traditional running race organized by the Prajzský běžecký klub Kravaře, held in the picturesque chateau park in Kravaře. The race offers an 8.7 km course for adults and shorter courses for children based on age groups. The surface consists of gravel paths, and the course follows three laps around the park. The event is suitable for recreational runners and families with children, with welcoming facilities and refreshments for all participants.

name: Půlmaraton okolo Prahy 4
description: The Half Marathon Around Prague 4 is a unique individual running event offering a meditative running experience on the varied terrain of an urban trail. The course is approximately 21 kilometres long and follows the perimeter of the Prague 4 district, giving participants the chance to get to know the area as well as assess their own running form. There is no mass start: runners set off individually or in small groups between 9:00 and 10:00, avoiding stress and congestion at the start and on the course. Following a successful debut, the half marathon is being held for the second time and is suitable for anyone who wants to combine athletic performance with an enjoyable experience in both nature and the city.

name: Chaloupecký kros
description: The Chaloupky Cross-Country Race is a traditional running event held in the picturesque surroundings of Chaloupky near Komárov. The race offers two main routes, approximately 8 km and 4 km long, which run along paved roads, forest trails, and meadows. The main race starts at 10:00, giving participants the chance to enjoy a combination of natural beauty and sporting challenge. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup and is suitable for the general public; there are no children’s categories.

name: Běh na Hraničář
description: Běh na Hraničář is a traditional and prestigious uphill race held in the picturesque setting of the forest amphitheatre by the Úhlava River in Nýrsko. The 5 km route, with 380 metres of elevation gain, passes the ruins of Pajrek Castle and finishes at the summit of Hraničář, offering a wonderful view of Mount Ostrý. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and, after a three-year break, has been held again since 2020. After the race, participants must make their own way back to the start.

name: Dobývání Dívčích hradů
description: The Conquest of Dívčí hrady is a 2 km uphill race with an elevation gain of 135 metres, held in Hlubočepy, Prague 5. The race is part of the Běhy do kopců v Praze a okolí series and offers runners the challenge of a demanding climb. The course passes through picturesque terrain with beautiful views, making the race appealing to fans of mountain running and hill running. It is suitable for anyone looking to test their endurance and strength on hilly terrain.

name: Unicredit Pražská štafeta RunCzech
description: The UniCredit Prague Relay is a team running event held on 16 June 2026 in Prague, featuring a relay race with four 5 km legs. The race starts at 18:00 in Stromovka Park, right in front of the Prague Exhibition Grounds in Holešovice, which is easily accessible by tram. The event is designed for teams and is ideal for corporate team-building, school events, or other groups looking to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and have fun together. After the race, a Team Box with comfortable facilities and catering is available for participants and their fans.

name: Kros Otakara Pachmanna
description: The Otakar Pachmann Cross-Country Race is a 4.4 km race through the beautiful natural surroundings of Krčský les in Prague 4. It is part of the SABZO series and gives runners the chance to enjoy natural terrain and a woodland atmosphere. It is suitable for anyone who enjoys running in nature and wants a sporting challenge in peaceful woodland surroundings.

name: 401. Malá cena Monaka
description: The Small Monaco Cup is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The race is part of the long-standing history of running events organized by the KRB Chrudim club and gives athletes the opportunity to test themselves on interesting courses. It is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to experience a high-quality sporting event in pleasant surroundings.

name: Běh olympijského dne
description: The Olympic Run is a traditional sporting event organized by the Czech Olympic Committee. It takes place as part of Olympic Day on June 17, 2026, in Zlín. The run brings together different generations and levels of runners, from children to adults, and promotes Olympic values such as friendship, fair play, and respect. Participants can choose from shorter and longer routes, and the race is accompanied by sports and educational activities. Entry fees support children’s participation in sports through the Czech Olympic Foundation. The event is open to everyone who wants to enjoy being active and support a good cause.

name: Olympijský běh - Zlín
description: The Olympic Run in Zlín is a traditional sporting event held at the Youth Stadium. The race offers a classic five-kilometre course on a tartan track for adults, as well as several shorter children’s races. The event supports sports activities for children from socially disadvantaged families, with part of the entry fee donated to the Czech Olympic Foundation. Registration takes place online, and the race starts at 18:00, with the start broadcast on Czech Radio.

name: Olympijský běh - Bakov nad Jizerou
description: The Olympic Run in Bakov nad Jizerou is a traditional race featuring a flat loop that runs partly along a dirt track and a meadow beside the Jizera River, with the final section on an inline skating track. The race is open to adults and children, with children’s races over 500 and 1,000 metres. The 5 km adult race starts at 18:00 and is held under the auspices of Czech Radio. Participants contribute to the Czech Olympic Foundation through their entry fees. Online registration is open until 5 June 2026; registration will not be available on site.

name: Olympijský běh - Bedřichov
description: The Olympic Run in Bedřichov is the largest running event in the Czech Republic and kicks off Olympic Day celebrations at more than 90 locations across the country. The race takes place in the picturesque Jizera Mountains, on a 5 km course. The main category starts at 18:00 by the stadium in Bedřichov. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to celebrate the spirit of sport and Olympic values.

name: Olympijský běh - Brloh
description: The Olympic Run in Brloh is a popular regional running race held on June 17, 2026. It is open to a wide range of ages, from children to seniors, and offers courses for both adults and children. The adult course is 5 km long and runs through the picturesque village along a stream, with a turnaround point by an oak tree. Children’s races take place on the track around the football field. The event is part of Olympic Day and supports the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Brno
description: The Olympic Run in Brno is a Gold Race taking place on June 17, 2026, on the meadow by the Komec sports complex in Brno-Komárov. The race offers 5 km and 10 km courses for adults, as well as 400 m and 800 m children’s races by age category. The event is part of the Olympic Day celebrations and features a sports program. The main race starts at 18:00 and will be started live on Czech Radio. Registration is available online only until June 5, 2026, and part of the entry fee goes to the Czech Olympic Foundation. Chip timing, a changing room, baggage storage, and toilets are available for participants.

name: Olympijský běh - Budyně nad Ohří
description: The Olympic Run in Budyně nad Ohří is a traditional sporting event held at the T.J. Sokol Budyně nad Ohří tennis courts. The 5.8 km main race runs across fields, through a small forest and over a gentle hill, on a mix of asphalt, field tracks and forest paths. Children can take part in 400 m and 1,000 m races in the safe surroundings of the tennis courts. The event is part of Olympic Day, which promotes sporting values and friendship, and also supports the Czech Olympic Foundation in helping children take part in sport.

name: Olympijský běh - Bystřice pod Hostýnem
description: The Olympic Run in Bystřice pod Hostýnem is a new addition to the running calendar. It takes place in the picturesque Zahájené town park, which combines nature with an urban atmosphere. The route is mostly on firm park paths, with short sections of slightly unpaved surface, and is suitable for experienced runners as well as families with children. During the race, participants can enjoy greenery, mature trees and peaceful parts of the park, with no significant elevation changes. The event is both a sporting and social gathering, with an accompanying program, refreshments and opportunities to cheer along the course. The entry fee supports the Czech Olympic Foundation, which helps children take part in sport.

name: Olympijský běh - Čelákovice
description: The Olympic Run in Čelákovice is a traditional running race, with its fifth edition taking place in 2026. The event offers two adult distances, 5 km and 10 km, on flat terrain along the Elbe River, with beautiful views and points of interest including the railway bridge, the Chapel of St. Wenceslas, and the courtyard of the Municipal Museum. Shorter children’s races from 200 m to 1,500 m are also available and pass through the Municipal Museum. The start and finish are on the athletics track at the Čelákovice Municipal Stadium. Online registration is open until June 5, 2026, and the main race starts at 18:00.

name: Olympijský běh - Červená Lhota
description: The Olympic Run in Červená Lhota is a traditional race that starts by the fairytale-like Červená Lhota Castle. Runners follow the blue hiking trail through the villages of Samosoly and Pohoří and across the dam of Kardaš Pond, mostly along field and forest paths. The race is ceremonially started with a shot from a historic weapon, and by taking part you support the Czech Olympic Foundation. The race is for adults over 15 and offers a pleasant sporting atmosphere, with refreshments provided by volunteer firefighters.

name: Olympijský běh - Červené Pečky
description: The Olympic Run in Červené Pečky is a new location in the Kolín area, offering a course suitable for beginners too. The adult main race is 4.5 km long and runs 90% over easy terrain around the football pitch and a small local wood, with the remaining 10% on asphalt. Shorter courses adapted to children’s age and ability are available. The event is part of Olympic Day and supports the Czech Olympic Foundation; part of the entry fee goes towards supporting children’s participation in sport.

name: Olympijský běh - Česká Lípa
description: The Olympic Run in Česká Lípa is a newcomer to the running map, centered around the renovated U Ploučnice municipal stadium. Runners head towards Holý vrch, the town’s western landmark, then return along the Ploučnice River to the stadium, where the start and finish are located. The event is open to adults and children, with several shorter races for children. The main race starts at 18:00, and online registration is open until 5 June 2026. By taking part, you contribute to the Czech Olympic Foundation, which supports children’s participation in sport.

name: Olympijský běh - Česká Skalice
description: The Olympic Run in Česká Skalice is part of the nationwide Olympic Day event, which celebrates sport and Olympic values such as friendship, fair play, and respect. The race offers routes for adults and children, and every participant contributes part of their entry fee to support children’s sports. The event is open to everyone, regardless of ability, and is an ideal opportunity to enjoy being active together in the beautiful Hradec Králové Region. The Olympic Run brings people and sports together for a day full of sporting activities and Olympic spirit.

name: Olympijský běh - České Budějovice
description: The Olympic Run in České Budějovice is a traditional race for fans of challenging terrain. The 7 km route crosses the U Špačků ford, follows the right bank of the Malše River to Roudné, and returns to the boathouse. The race is open to adults and children, with a separate 1.5 km route for the children’s races. Participants’ entry fees support the Czech Olympic Foundation. The main race starts at 18:00 by the Hanace boathouse in České Budějovice.

name: Olympijský běh - Dačice
description: The Olympic Run in Dačice is a traditional sporting event held in the beautiful grounds of the Dačice State Chateau park. The race follows a route mainly along forest and field paths, suitable for adults and children. The event also features an accompanying program, with the option to visit the chateau and the town museum. Participants’ entry fees support the Czech Olympic Foundation, which encourages children to take part in sport.

name: Olympijský běh - Děčín
description: The Olympic Run in Děčín is a traditional regional race held at the confluence of the Elbe and Ploučnice rivers. The start and finish are located in front of the Kajak Děčín boathouse. The 4.6 km main race route follows a cycle path almost through the city centre, with asphalt and paved surfaces. The event also includes children’s races over distances from 200 to 1,000 metres. Participants can enjoy the beautiful surroundings, with views of Děčín Castle, the Elbe Canyon and lookout towers, while also supporting the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Dřevěnice
description: The Olympic Run in Dřevěnice is a traditional regional running race with a course of approximately five kilometres. It starts with a challenging climb into the forest above the Dolánky part of the municipality, then heads to a pond, where the course continues on flat asphalt roads, crossing the main road. The finish is at the volleyball courts, which have full facilities. The race is suitable for adults and children, with shorter children’s races ranging from 50 to 1,200 metres. The race starts at 18:00, and registration is available online only until 5 June 2026.

name: Olympijský běh - Háj ve Slezsku
description: The Olympic Run in Háj ve Slezsku is part of the nationwide Olympic Day, which celebrates sport and Olympic values. The event offers courses for adults and children, including a shorter 4 km and a longer 8 km course for adults, as well as children’s races ranging from 60 to 1,000 metres. The start is at the school sports grounds of ZŠ Háj ve Slezsku, and the event has a welcoming atmosphere, with the opportunity to donate to the Czech Olympic Foundation. Registration is online, and the event is suitable for the general public, who can enjoy a route through the village and around the athletics track.

name: Olympijský běh - Havířov
description: The Olympic Run in Havířov is part of the country’s largest running event, which kicks off Olympic Day celebrations at more than 90 locations across the Czech Republic. The race takes place on June 17, 2026, and offers a 5 km course in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The main category starts at 18:00 by the Na Vyhlídce non-alcoholic bar in Havířov. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to celebrate the sporting day with a run.

name: Olympijský běh - Hluboké Mašůvky
description: The Olympic Run in Hluboké Mašůvky is part of the nationwide Olympic Day, which celebrates sport and Olympic values such as friendship, fair play and respect. The event offers a 5 km adult race and children’s races of 100, 200 and 300 metres. The start is at the football pitch in Hluboké Mašůvky. The main race begins at 18:00 and is started live on Český rozhlas. Participants make a contribution to the Czech Olympic Foundation, which supports children’s participation in sport. Toilets, a changing room, a baggage storage area and showers are available, and children can enjoy a bouncy castle.

name: Olympijský běh - Holešov
description: The Olympic Run in Holešov is the country’s largest running event, kicking off Olympic Day celebrations at more than 90 locations across the Czech Republic. The race takes place in the beautiful setting of the château gardens in Holešov and offers a mixed 5 km race. The main category starts at 18:00, making it an enjoyable evening run for the general public and athletes alike. The event is part of the broader running movement of the Czech Athletics Federation, which promotes running and a healthy lifestyle.

name: Olympijský běh - Holetín
description: The Olympic Run in Holetín returns after a break with a varied route along roads, paved paths, meadows and field trails. The race is open to adults and children, and by taking part you contribute to the Czech Olympic Foundation. The start and registration are at the Holetín swimming pool complex, which also has basic amenities. The race starts at 18:00, announced on Czech Radio, and online registration is available until 5 June 2026.

name: Olympijský běh - Horní Jelení
description: The Olympic Run in Horní Jelení is a traditional running race with a beautiful route through the local forest and around Pětinoha Pond. It offers races for adults and children, including a 6 km race for adults and shorter 2.5 km and 500 m races for children in different age categories. The race takes place at Komenského Square and starts at 18:00. The atmosphere is friendly, and the event supports the Czech Olympic Foundation. Registration is online, and the race is timed using chip timing.

name: Olympijský běh - Horoměřice
description: The Olympic Run in Horoměřice offers a 7 km running course completed in two laps. The route is mostly dirt and gravel, with sections of paving stones and concrete slabs. Two-thirds of each lap run gently downhill, while the final third challenges runners with an uphill stretch. Horoměřice is hosting the Olympic Run for the sixth time, and part of the entry fee is donated to the Czech Olympic Foundation. The race is suitable for adults and children, with shorter 500 m and 1,000 m races for children.

name: Olympijský běh - Hradec Králové
description: The Olympic Run in Hradec Králové is the country’s largest running event, kicking off Olympic Day celebrations at more than 90 locations across the Czech Republic. The race takes place on 17 June 2026, starting at 18:00 near ZŠ Štefánikova, and features a 5 km course. The event is open to the general public and runners of all abilities who want to celebrate this sporting day by running. It is organized by a team of organizers under the auspices of the Czech Athletics Federation.

name: Olympijský běh - Hudčice
description: The Olympic Run in Hudčice is a traditional regional race held on a loop around the village, along paved and dirt roads, including a climb to the quarries above the village. There are also children’s races over 200 and 700 metres. The event is open to all age groups and supports the Czech Olympic Foundation. The main race starts at 18:00, and registration is online only until 5 June 2026.

name: Olympijský běh - Chlumec nad Cidlinou
description: The Olympic Run in Chlumec nad Cidlinou is a traditional regional race held on the athletics track by Slavíček Hall. The route follows paved and dirt roads, starting and finishing at the stadium. The race is part of the Olympic Day celebrations, and participants’ entry fees support the Czech Olympic Foundation’s work promoting children’s participation in sport. Alongside the main race for adults, there is also a children’s race, making it possible for the whole family and sports enthusiasts of all ages to take part.

name: Olympijský běh - Chomutov
description: The Olympic Run in Chomutov takes place in the picturesque Bezruč Valley, where the pleasant climate and shade provide ideal conditions for achieving great results.
