The race features out-and-back road routes with a gentle climb to the turnarounds, rewarding runners in the second half of the race. Both shorter and longer routes are available: 10 km and 5 km, respectively. The event is suitable for the general public and supports the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Chotiměř
description: The Olympic Run in Chotiměř is part of the country’s largest running event, which kicks off Olympic Day celebrations at more than 90 locations across the Czech Republic. The race takes place on June 17, 2026, and features a 6 km mixed-surface course starting at the municipal office in Chotiměř. The main category starts at 18:00. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to celebrate the day through running.

name: Olympijský běh - Ivančice
description: The Olympic Run in Ivančice is part of a nationwide celebration of Olympic Day, bringing together athletes of all ages. The adult race runs mostly on sandy terrain along the Jihlava and Rokytná rivers, with natural landmarks at U Šneka and U Dvou bobrů. Children’s races take place on the athletics track, which is also the start and finish venue for the adult races. By taking part, you contribute to the Czech Olympic Foundation, which supports children’s participation in sport. The main race starts at 18:00 at the Ivančice Municipal Stadium.

name: Olympijský běh - Jihlava
description: The Olympic Run in Jihlava traditionally takes place at the summer cinema venue and athletics track, offering a family-friendly atmosphere full of support and the joy of movement. The race is open to all age groups, with courses for adults and children on mixed terrain. Participants’ entry fees support the Czech Olympic Foundation, which helps children take part in sports. The main race starts at 18:00, and the event is part of the wider Olympic Day, celebrating sport and Olympic values.

name: Olympijský běh - Kamenice
description: The Olympic Run in Kamenice is a traditional regional race that has been held since 2016 in the picturesque Vysočina region. The race offers moderately challenging routes on unpaved paths and asphalt roads around three Kamenice ponds, with a choice of a shorter 2.5 km loop or a longer 5 km loop. Special routes of varying lengths are prepared for children according to age categories. Participants support the Czech Olympic Foundation through their entry fees, helping to promote sports among children. The main race starts at 18:00, and registration is online only until 5 June 2026.

name: Olympijský běh - Karviná
description: The Olympic Run in Karviná is a traditional race starting in the historic T. G. Masaryk Square in Karviná-Fryštát. The route passes the Larisch family chateau and through the chateau park, then heads to the city’s landmark, the Darkov Bridge, before returning via the Spa Park to the finish. The race is open to adults and children up to 15 years old, with shorter courses for the children’s races. The event supports the Czech Olympic Foundation and offers a friendly atmosphere, an accompanying programme, and the opportunity for athletes with disabilities to participate in wheelchairs (handbikes).

name: Olympijský běh - Klášterec nad Orlicí
description: The Olympic Run in Klášterec nad Orlicí is part of the country’s largest running event, which kicks off Olympic Day celebrations at more than 90 locations across the Czech Republic. The race takes place on the asphalt court by the Sokol Hall and offers 10 km and 5 km courses. The main category starts at 18:00, and the race is suitable for the general public as well as athletes. It is organized by a team of organizers in cooperation with the Czech Athletics Federation.

name: Olympijský běh - Kolín
description: The Olympic Run in Kolín is a traditional sporting event being held for the fourth time as part of the Czech Olympic Committee’s nationwide Olympic Day event. The races take place in the picturesque Borky Forest Park, with two routes: 3 km for adults and 1 km for children. The routes follow forest paths and a cycle path along the Elbe, offering beautiful views and a pleasant running surface. There’s a bouncy castle for children and a photo booth for all participants. The atmosphere is full of sporting spirit and camaraderie. The start and finish are by the bears in Borky Forest Park.

name: Olympijský běh - Kralice nad Oslavou
description: The Olympic Run in Kralice nad Oslavou is a regional running race on a 4 km route along a dirt track and partly on an asphalt road. The race is open to adults and children, with children’s races ranging from 250 to 800 metres. The start is by the football pitch, and the main race begins at 18:00, launched on air by Czech Radio. Participants’ entry fees go to the Czech Olympic Foundation. Registration is online only, until 5 June 2026; registration will not be available on site.

name: Olympijský běh - Krymlov
description: The Olympic Run in Krymlov is a traditional regional race held to celebrate Olympic Day. The event offers a 6.5 km course for adults, as well as children’s races of 200 m and 800 m. The start and registration are in the center of the village by Krymlovská hospoda, where refreshments are available before and after the race. Part of the entry fee is donated to the Czech Olympic Foundation, supporting sports development.

name: Olympijský běh - Liberec
description: The Olympic Run in Liberec is a traditional sporting event held at the Sport Park Liberec complex on the inline skating track around the athletics stadium. It offers races for children and adults, with distances from 150 metres up to 6 km, suitable for the general public, including wheelchair users and handbike riders. The main race starts at 18:00. Registration is online only, with the option to register multiple runners at once. The programme also includes a group warm-up and facilities with toilets, changing rooms, showers and a baggage storage area. The entry fee supports the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Líbeznice
description: The Olympic Run in Líbeznice is a new addition to this traditional sporting event, which brings together runners of all ages. The races take place at Areál zdraví, which offers modern sports facilities in the peaceful, leafy surroundings of the village, known for its interesting architectural features. The routes follow asphalt, paved and unpaved paths through the village and surrounding area, including the Mratínka trail, which was created from a former railway spur. The event is not only a sporting occasion but also an opportunity to support the Czech Olympic Foundation and enjoy a friendly atmosphere and the joy of movement.

name: Olympijský běh - Lovosice
description: The Olympic Run in Lovosice is part of the country’s largest running event, which kicks off Olympic Day celebrations at 90 locations across the Czech Republic. The race takes place at the athletics stadium in Lovosice and offers 8 km and 4 km courses. The main category starts at 18:00, and the race is open to runners of all abilities and sports enthusiasts. It is organized by a team of organizers under the auspices of the Czech Athletics Federation.

name: Olympijský běh - Mělník
description: The Olympic Run in Mělník is a traditional race held amid the picturesque natural landscape of the Elbe Lowlands, around the Elbe River and Na Polabí Park. The children’s races take place on unpaved paths in the park, while adults run along a paved asphalt cycle path with no elevation gain. The event is suitable for the general public and supports the Czech Olympic Foundation. The main race starts at 18:00, and registration is online only until June 5, 2026.

name: Olympijský běh - Město Touškov
description: The Olympic Run in Město Touškov is a traditional regional race that passes through the town’s historic centre, by the Baroque Church of St. John the Baptist and the Touškov pond. The course combines grass and asphalt surfaces and offers an enjoyable run through picturesque surroundings. The race is open to adults and children, with several course distances, and also supports the Czech Olympic Foundation. The start and registration are at the TJ Sokol sports complex. The main race starts at 18:00 and is started live on Czech Radio.

name: Olympijský běh - Most
description: The Olympic Run in Most takes place in the Matylda recreation area and offers two routes for adults—a shorter 4 km and a longer 8 km course—along the paved inline skating path around Lake Matylda. The race starts at 18:00 and is started live on Český rozhlas radio. Participants’ entry fees support the Czech Olympic Foundation. Registration is online only until June 6; registration will not be available on site. Showers, toilets, a changing room and a baggage storage facility are available for runners. Parking is available in the Matylda area.

name: Olympijský běh - Olomouc
organizer: Český olympijský výbor a Klub vytrvalostních sportů Olomouc
description: The Olympic Run in Olomouc is part of the T-Mobile Olympic Run and offers a bronze-level race with a charitable dimension. The event takes place in Olomouc-Hejčín and includes a 5 km adult race and free children’s races for children up to 15 years old. The race starts at 6 p.m., with the start broadcast on Czech Radio. The entry fee includes a race pack with a sports bag and gifts from partners, and part of the fee goes to support the Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Opava Suché Lazce
description: The Olympic Run in Opava-Suché Lazce is the country’s largest running event, kicking off Olympic Day celebrations at more than 90 locations across the Czech Republic. The race covers a 5 km course and is open to the general public and sports enthusiasts alike. It starts at the municipal football pitch at 18:00, and the event has a friendly, motivating atmosphere for all runners. It is organized by a team of organizers under the auspices of the Czech Athletic Federation.

name: Olympijský běh - Ostrava Hošťálkovice
description: The Olympic Run in Ostrava-Hošťálkovice is a traditional running race on paved paths over rolling terrain. It offers two routes for adults—a longer 10 km route and a shorter 5 km route—with the start at the sports complex by ZŠ Výhledy-Hošťálkovice. Children may also take part with permission from a legal guardian, and the event contributes to the Czech Olympic Foundation. The main race starts at 18:00 and is started live on Czech Radio. Toilets, changing rooms, showers, and parking are available by MŠ Výhledy.

name: Olympijský běh - Ostrava Komenského sady
description: The Olympic Run in Ostrava’s Komenský Gardens is a traditional sporting event held in a beautiful park along the Ostravice River. The race offers routes for adults and children. The main race starts at 18:00 and is broadcast on Czech Radio. By taking part, participants contribute to the Czech Olympic Foundation, which supports children’s participation in sport. Registration is online, and the race is suitable for the general public, including wheelchair users and handbikes.

name: Olympijský běh - Ostrov u Karlových Varů
description: The Olympic Run in Ostrov near Karlovy Vary is part of Olympic Day, which celebrates sport and Olympic values. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of the castle park and follows a sandy path. Participants can run the 5 km course, and online registration is open until 5 June 2026. The main race starts at 18:00, and the event is suitable for the general public, including children accompanied by an adult.

name: Olympijský běh - Palkovice
description: The Olympic Run in Palkovice is a traditional regional race held in beautiful surroundings, with a combination of paved roads, forest paths and terrain. The adult course is approximately 5,100 metres long and includes a hill, adding interest and challenge to the race. Children can take part in races over 200 m, 400 m and 1,600 m, making it an event for the whole family. The event is also an opportunity to support the Czech Olympic Foundation and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in the community. The start and registration are behind the gym in Palkovice; the main race starts at 18:00.

name: Olympijský běh - Pardubice
description: The Olympic Run in Pardubice is a traditional race held in the Studánka forest park. The 3.8 km course runs mainly along forest paths with some asphalt sections and is suitable for beginners thanks to its mostly flat terrain with a few climbs. The event also includes 1.1 km children’s races. Participants make a contribution to the Czech Olympic Foundation, and can choose to register with or without a T-shirt.

name: Olympijský běh - Pelhřimov
description: The Olympic Run in Pelhřimov is a traditional running race held in a picturesque town on the edge of the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands. The race offers courses for children and adults, including a longer 7.2 km route and a shorter 4.8 km route, which run through the town parks and surrounding area. The start is at the Senior Citizens’ Home on Radětínská Street, and the race supports the Czech Olympic Foundation. Online registration is available, with the option to sign up multiple runners at once. Pelhřimov is also known for its historic landmarks and Festival of Records and Curiosities, giving the race a unique atmosphere.

name: Olympijský běh - Praha Královka
description: The Olympic Run in Prague – Královka is part of the nationwide celebration of Olympic Day, bringing together sports enthusiasts of all ages. The race offers adult runners a challenging 3.8 km course that runs mainly on paved paths through the park, with some unpaved sections, including stairs and uneven terrain. Shorter distances of 350 m, 550 m and 1,100 m are available for children. By taking part, you contribute to the Czech Olympic Foundation, which supports children with limited financial means in pursuing sport. The main race starts at 18:00. Registration is online only and is open until 5 June 2026.

name: Olympijský běh - Praha Satalice
description: The Olympic Run in Prague-Satalice is a 5 km race that runs mainly along forest trails in the Satalice Game Reserve, a chestnut-lined avenue, and gravel paths in the forest park. The route is flat and offers runners a pleasant setting, with views over fields and a course that passes the Chapel of St. Anne. A warm-up is provided before the start, and motivational announcements are made during the race. After the race, refreshments, showers, changing rooms, and a bag storage area are available, all in a friendly atmosphere. Part of the entry fee is donated to the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Rožnov pod Radhoštěm
description: The Olympic Run in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm is part of the largest running event in the Czech Republic, which is being held for the 40th year. On race day, June 17, sports enthusiasts of all ages can enjoy running and other physical activities. The event is also open to sports clubs and associations, which can organize their own Olympic Day. Registration is available only online on the official website until June 5, with the best entry fee for adults available until the end of March.

name: Olympijský běh - Rychnov nad Kněžnou
description: The Olympic Run in Rychnov nad Kněžnou is returning to the running calendar after a long break and invites all runners to celebrate Olympic Day through movement. The main adult race is 5 km long and starts at the swimming pool complex in Včelné. Children can take part in races from 200 m to 1,500 m, depending on their age category. The event also offers an accompanying program, the chance to try SPARTAN obstacles, and facilities including a bag drop, toilets, and showers. Registration is online, with the option to sign up multiple runners at once, and the entry fee contributes to the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Strakonice
description: The Olympic Run in Strakonice is a traditional sporting event being held for the third time at the Podskalí campsite. The race offers routes for adults and children, with adults running 4 km on a mix of natural and paved paths. Children can take part in races of 350 m and 1.2 km, accompanied by an Olympic-themed programme. The main race starts at 18:00, and part of the entry fee goes to the Czech Olympic Foundation. The event is suitable for all age groups and promotes the joy of movement and a good cause.

name: Olympijský běh - Stříbro
description: The Olympic Run in Stříbro is a traditional running race that takes place mostly along forest paths and supports Olympic ideals and the Czech Olympic Foundation. The program includes a 5 km race for adults and children’s races of 600 and 1,000 metres. The event is held at the TJ Baník Stříbro stadium and offers a pleasant sporting environment, with online registration available. The main race starts at 18:00. Participants have access to changing rooms, toilets, showers and storage. The race is also open to athletes with disabilities using wheelchairs (handbikes).

name: Olympijský běh - Tachov
description: The Olympic Run in Tachov gives runners the chance to take on a mixed course combining natural and asphalt sections along the Mže River. The race is open to both children aged 15 and under and adults, with a capacity of 100 adult and 100 child participants. The start and registration are at the Tachov Sports Complex – Rychta. The main race starts at 18:00 and is started live on Czech Radio. Registration is online only until June 7; on-site registration will not be available. By purchasing an entry, you contribute CZK 20 to the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Tlučeň
description: The Olympic Run in Tlučeň offers a run along forest trails through the České středohoří hills, around Plešivec, with approximately 180 metres of elevation gain—one of the highest elevation gains among Olympic Runs. The route is shaded and is open to adults and children, with shorter courses for the children’s races. The event is part of Olympic Day and supports the Czech Olympic Foundation. The main race starts at 18:00, and the accompanying programme includes, for example, an aikido demonstration. Online registration is open until 5 June 2026; registration will not be available on site.

name: Olympijský běh - Trutnov
description: After last year’s debut, the Olympic Run in Trutnov returns for its second edition. The race offers a 5 km route with mixed terrain, starting at the athletics stadium and passing the swimming pool before following forest paths along the Poříčský Ridge, with the finish back at the stadium. Children’s races of 100 to 800 metres will take place in the stadium grounds. The event is not only a sporting challenge but also an opportunity to support a good cause, as part of the entry fee goes to the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Tuhaň
description: The Olympic Run in Tuhan is a traditional race held in the beautiful Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area. The route runs mainly through forests and meadows, with part of it on an asphalt road, offering a pleasant running experience in nature. The event also includes children’s races on the football pitch, making it suitable for the whole family. The main race starts at 18:00, and the event is also an opportunity to support the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Ústí nad Labem
description: The Olympic Run in Ústí nad Labem is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Lake Milada. The race offers routes for adults and children, with a choice of shorter or longer routes for adults. The start is near the car park above Lake Milada’s main beach, and the route follows the water before climbing gently to the finish. Part of the entry fee is donated to the Czech Olympic Foundation to support children’s participation in sport. The race is suitable for the general public who want to enjoy being active and support a good cause.

name: Olympijský běh - Valašské Klobouky
description: The Olympic Run in Valašské Klobouky is a traditional sporting event held in the beautiful, hilly landscape of the White Carpathians. The race offers two main routes for adults—a 5-kilometre and a 10-kilometre course—run mostly on asphalt. Children’s races are also held in the enclosed area of the football pitch. The start is at the TJ Spartak Valašské Klobouky football pitch, and participants make a donation to the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Vnorovy
description: The Olympic Run in Vnorovy is a traditional regional race on a 6.5 km course along local roads, field tracks and forest paths. Part of the route runs between the Morava River and the Baťa Canal, including a crossing over the Baťa Canal lock. The start and finish are on the athletics track at the Vnorovy sports complex. The race is open to adults and children, with shorter children’s races ranging from 100 to 1,000 metres. Participants make a contribution to the Czech Olympic Foundation.

name: Olympijský běh - Lelekovice
description: The Olympic Run in Lelekovice is a traditional race held on Olympic Day. The routes run mostly along field and forest paths, with gently rolling terrain and a steep climb before the finish. The main race is 5 km and is suitable for adults and children, while the children’s races cover shorter distances of 150 to 1,060 metres. After the race, prizes are awarded not only to the winners but also to runners selected by draw and older participants, followed by a get-together around a fire with music and the option to roast food. Online registration is open until 5 June 2026, and the main race starts at 18:00.

name: Komořany – Čihadlo
description: Komořany - Čihadlo is a 4.88 km running race with 175 metres of elevation gain, held entirely on forest and field paths. The finish is at the summit of Čihadlo. The race is part of the Hill Running Series in Prague and the surrounding area, offering runners an enjoyable experience in a natural setting on a more challenging course.

name: Běh okolo Špilberku
description: The Run Around Špilberk is a traditional running race in Brno, featuring an interesting course around Špilberk Castle. The race is open to men, women, and children of all ages and takes place in the pleasant early evening. Men run five 1.3 km laps, women run three laps, and the lap length for children is adjusted according to age. Refreshments and a baggage drop-off are available after the race. The affordable entry fee is 150 CZK, and registration takes place at the venue before the race.

name: Radimovický koňák
description: Radimovický koňák is a traditional cross-country race held in the village of Radimovice u Želče, attracting runners of all ages every year. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of South Bohemia and offers everyone from the youngest children to adult men, who make up the largest category, the chance to test their strength. The event has a long-standing tradition and is a popular sporting occasion in the region.

name: Krakonosova stovka
description: Krakonošova stovka is a traditional long-distance hike with a history dating back to 1966. The 100 km route crosses the challenging mountain terrain of the Krkonoše Mountains, with over 3,000 metres of elevation gain. It starts and finishes in Vrchlabí and passes notable places such as Špindlerův Mlýn, Sněžka and Pec pod Sněžkou. In addition to the main K100 route, shorter options are available: K50, K25 and the B25 running route. The event is for endurance hikers and runners who want to experience the beauty of the Krkonoše Mountains within a challenging 24-hour time limit.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain terrain with over 3,000 m of elevation gain
The route passes through Špindlerův Mlýn, Sněžka and Pec pod Sněžkou
Start and finish in Vrchlabí
additional: UMARA isotonic drinks are available at selected checkpoints. UMARA sports nutrition can be purchased before the start. Parking is limited due to a road closure; participants are advised to use the designated car parks and not obstruct traffic. According to the official website, registration for the 2027 edition is expected to open on 1 February 2027. Information on the price, time limit and refreshments available for K100 applies to the 2026 edition.

name: Běh metropole MČ Praha 14 - Večerní běh
description: The Běh metropole MČ Praha 14 - Evening Run is part of the BĚH METROPOLE series of public running races, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and a sense of belonging among Prague residents to their city district. The race takes place in Kejřův Park and offers a pleasant evening-running atmosphere, with the opportunity to represent your district. The start is scheduled for the evening, adding to the unique experience of running in an urban setting. The organizers emphasize competition and community spirit among participants of all ages.

name: Okolo Rudného
description: Okolo Rudného is a running race in the Vysočina region offering two distances: 8.2 km for men and 4.2 km for women. The route follows unpaved forest roads and trails, providing a pleasant running experience in nature. The race is part of the Běžec Vysočiny Cup and is suitable for runners looking for a trail run with a gentle profile. Okolo Rudného is a traditional race that attracts runners from the region and surrounding areas.

name: Velíšskej přespolňák
description: Velíšskej přespolňák is a cross-country race for experienced runners, enthusiasts, and amateurs, held in the picturesque Podblanicko region. The race offers two routes, 10 km and 5.2 km long, running mainly along field and forest paths for an enjoyable running experience in nature. This race is ideal for anyone who wants to enjoy running in a clean environment while testing their abilities against other runners. Velíšskej přespolňák is a traditional event that attracts a wide running community.

name: Prague Park Race – Divoká Šárka
description: Prague Park Race – Divoká Šárka is a running race taking place on June 20, 2026, amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6. The race offers a unique atmosphere and breathtaking views for runners to enjoy on routes of 8 and 14 kilometres. The routes follow paved and unpaved roads, meadows and trails, as well as some asphalt roads with limited traffic. The race is suitable for the general public and offers refreshments along the course and at the finish. The start and registration take place at the SK ARITMA grounds in Prague-Vokovice, which are easily accessible by public transport and by car.

name: Krosový běh Chudenickým Žďárem
location: Chudenice, sportovní areál Jalovčí, hřiště pod Bolfánkem, Plzeňský
description: The Run through Chudenice’s Žďár is a young cross-country race founded in 2016. It takes place amid the picturesque autumn scenery of Žďár Hill above the village of Chudenice. The course is a challenging cross-country run with no asphalt sections, a gently undulating profile, and an appealing climb up the forest steps to Bolfánek. The start and finish are located at the local sports club grounds. The main race is 6.2 km long and offers runners both a challenge and beautiful natural scenery.

name: Příborský běh
organizer: město Příbor, Atletický klub Emila Zátopka Kopřivnice
description: The Příbor Run is a traditional running race organized by the town of Příbor in cooperation with the Scout troop and the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice. The race is open to both competitive runners and recreational runners, who can choose a distance to suit their abilities. The options include a 4.6 km recreational race, a 9.2 km competitive race, and relays made up of four runners (2 men + 2 women), with each runner completing a 2.3 km lap. There are also children’s races over various distances. The race has a friendly atmosphere and supports the region’s broad running community.

name: Běh Jana Opletala
description: The In the Footsteps of Jan Opletal Run and Jiří Vacek Memorial is a traditional running event organised by the Jan Opletal Grammar School in Litovel. The race commemorates notable figures and the history of the school and town. It takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the Litovel region and is suitable for the general public looking to enjoy a sporting experience with a historical dimension.

name: Běh okolo Vraní skály
description: The Run Around Vraní Skála is a traditional running race held in Černín near Zdice, featuring a challenging course approximately 9 km long. The race combines a steep uphill road section, forest trails and narrow paths leading to the summit around Vraní Skála, followed by a rolling, mostly downhill section with a steep descent to the finish. The race starts in the square in Černín near Zdice, and the main race begins at 10:30. It is part of the Brdy Running Cup and is suitable for runners who enjoy a combination of road and trail running with significant elevation gain.

name: Běh na Kozlovský kopec
description: The Kozlovský kopec Run is a traditional road hill race in Česká Třebová, taking place on 20 June 2026. The race starts at 10:00 on Habrmanova Street, in front of the Secondary Vocational School building, and finishes at Max Švabinský Cottage on Kozlovský kopec. The 5.2 km course climbs 230 metres on asphalt and is among the more challenging races in the regional ISCAREX Cup series and the Czech Hill Running Cup. Race facilities are in the school building, where registration, changing rooms and toilets are available. You can register online in advance for a reduced entry fee or on race day.

name: Běh Memoriálu Petry Hézlové - MPH 2026 Louny
description: The Petra Hézlová Memorial is a charity sporting event held in Louny, offering running races for adults and children. The main race features 5 km and 10 km courses for men, women, and students, timed using chip timing. The event is part of a family sports afternoon and offers a varied programme of activities alongside the races. All participants receive a wooden commemorative medal, and there is a prize draw for a LIFEFIT.PRO treadmill. The memorial supports health and social projects, especially oncology.

name: Krakonošova pětadvacítka - B25
description: Krakonošova pětadvacítka (B25) is a 25-kilometer trail run held in Vrchlabí and part of the Krakonošova stovka race series. The course crosses mountainous terrain with approximately 903 meters of elevation gain and offers challenging conditions suited to experienced runners. The event takes place every June and attracts participants from across the Czech Republic who want to enjoy the beauty of the Krkonoše Mountains and the challenge of a mountain run.

name: FarmaRun
description: FarmaRun 2026 is a family sports event organized by the Libchavští chlupáči animal sanctuary farm in Horní Libchava. The race offers a main 5 km run along a pleasantly shaded, flat cycle path, suitable for both runners and walkers. Children can take part in a short 300 m run, and there is an exhibition race for the youngest children, aged 4 and under, right on the farm grounds. After the race, participants receive a commemorative medal, a refreshing drink, and light refreshments. There is also an accompanying program for the whole family.

name: Velíšskej přespolňák
description: Velíšskej přespolňák is a traditional cross-country race with a long history, held in Louny in the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race is open to all age groups and offers a range of distances, from children’s races to the men’s 7,800-metre event. The Lucky Náprstková Memorial commemorates a tragic event and is part of this sporting event. The organizer is the Czech Union of Sport, which encourages the general public to stay active and participate in sport.

name: Revírní POHO běh
description: The Revírní poho běh project is a unique running race for adults and children alike, set amid the breathtaking natural surroundings of the Karviná Sea. Inspired by the region’s mining history, it makes use of the potential of the post-mining landscape and its revitalized environment. Its aim is to introduce this unique place to the public and to athletes. With the motto “Run in POHO!”, the race offers routes for everyone and the joy of movement.
additional: Also featured: a 4 × 6 km relay race, children’s races, and a health festival

name: Běhej lesy Týmovka - týmový závod
description: Běhej lesy Týmovka is a unique team relay running race held in the heart of the Vysočina region, offering an adventure for teams of 4 to 8 runners. The race consists of three different loops with a total distance of approximately 27.5 km, which each runner must complete over the weekend. The race also takes place at night with headlamps, adding to its uniqueness and challenge. In addition to the race, a rich programme of sports activities, cultural events and workshops is planned, while the facilities include a comfortable campsite with sanitary facilities and refreshments.

name: Velichovská sedmička
description: Velichovská sedmička is a friendly family running race held in the village of Velichovky, offering a main 7 km course along forest trails and local roads. The race is open to all age groups, including children, and encourages active leisure time in nature. The event is part of the Primátor Cup series and is ideal for sports enthusiasts and families looking for a shared sporting activity. It takes place on the last Saturday in June, with the option to take part in other shorter routes and children’s categories.

name: ČEZ RunTour Plzeň
description: ČEZ RunTour Plzeň is a family-friendly running event with a joyful, relaxed atmosphere, suitable for both recreational and elite runners. It offers a range of distances, from children’s races to 3, 5 and 10 km runs and a half marathon. The race takes place in the centre of Plzeň and is part of a series of events held throughout the Czech Republic. Participants can enjoy not only the race but also a family-friendly entertainment programme and high-quality service from start to finish.

name: Dobratický běh
description: The Dobratice Run is a traditional running race in the picturesque village of Dobratice, attracting sports enthusiasts of all ages. The race offers beautiful routes through nature and scenic surroundings, suitable for both experienced runners and families with children. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, themed categories, and valuable prizes for winners and participants. Each year brings a new theme, giving the race a unique atmosphere and adding to the joy of running.

name: Hamelika třikrát jinak
description: Hamelika Three Ways is a running race organized by Pro Sport Activities at the Hamelika site near Mariánské Lázně. The race is part of the Rozhledny v pohybu series and the Plzeň Region Running Cup, offering a sporting experience for the general public. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels, with an emphasis on a welcoming setting and a sporting atmosphere. Pro Sport Activities has a long tradition of organizing running races and looks forward to welcoming participants in 2026.

name: Sunrise Marathon / Halfmaraton
description: The Sunrise Marathon and Half Marathon take place on June 21, 2026, at Olympia Brno, Modřice. The race starts early in the morning at 4:46 so runners can experience the magical atmosphere of sunrise during the run. The course is flat and consists of five equal-length laps, running partly through nature and partly along shaded sections. The organizers provide electronic timing and support at key points along the course. The race is suitable for all runners who want to welcome summer actively and enjoy a unique running experience at dawn.

name: Hradecký kros
description: Hradecký kros is a traditional 10 km trail race held in the forests around Biřička in Hradec Králové. The race offers a unique experience on natural terrain with fewer asphalt sections, making it suitable for the general public and recreational runners alike. The event is part of the East Bohemia Running Grand Prix and attracts runners of all levels every year. The course consists of two 5 km laps over mildly undulating terrain, highlighting the race’s beauty and challenge.

name: Ivčin kopeček
description: Ivčin kopeček is a 3.4 km uphill race with 240 metres of elevation gain, part of the Běhy do kopců series in Prague and the surrounding area. The race offers runners a challenging yet appealing course in the beautiful natural surroundings of Beroun in the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for fans of mountain running and uphill running who want to test their endurance and strength on a short but intense route. The race is open to the public and welcomes all runners looking to enjoy a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere.

name: Kros Sázava
description: Kros Sázava is a running race in Pikovice, Central Bohemian Region, offering three routes of varying distances and elevation gains. The longest route is 15.5 km with approximately 500 m of elevation gain, the medium route is 10 km with approximately 230 m, and the hobby route is 5 km with 120 m. All routes run exclusively through nature, offering beautiful and challenging running experiences. The race is suitable for runners of various levels who want to enjoy cross-country running in a picturesque setting.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (7) – červnový
description: Come and run on a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava River in Prague’s Braník district, where personal records are often set! The race is part of the 16th edition of VAŠE LIGA’s regular 5 km and 10 km runs, held every month. The course has been measured by a certified measurer, and the 10 km race offers the chance to achieve the qualifying time for the Czech Championships. After the race, you can review your performance and refuel at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex. We reward both the top runners and our loyal participants.

name: Běh Vídrholcem
description: The Vídrholec Run is a popular running race held in Prague 9-Klánovice. It is part of the local running calendar and attracts runners of all levels who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a picturesque setting. The event is held under the auspices of the Czech Running Association and the Czech Athletics Federation, and offers not only competition but also the joy of exercising in nature.

name: Excalibur Race MOON Zámek Duchcov
description: Excalibur Race MOON Duchcov Castle is an obstacle race taking place from June 26 to 28, 2026, in the historic grounds of the state-owned Duchcov Castle and its surroundings. Runners will follow in the footsteps of the legendary Giacomo Casanova and take on a fast course with beautiful views of the Ore Mountains, the Central Bohemian Uplands, and the foothills of the Bílina mine. The race features modern, certified obstacles on professional ALU structures, with an emphasis on safety and quality. The atmosphere is enhanced by a medieval-knight theme that connects the physical challenge with the values of honor, loyalty, and cooperation. A varied program and facilities, including refreshments and services, are available for runners and fans.

name: Běh týnišťskými pralesy
description: The Run through the Týniště Forests is a charity race held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Týniště nad Orlicí, offering courses for different fitness levels and age groups. The race takes place in a forest, mainly on firm forest paths, with some paved sections. The event includes a free family run for children under 18 and main races of 6, 10 and 21 km. It brings sport, families and support for a good cause together, benefiting RENEDA, a nonprofit organization that helps children facing neurological challenges.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v dlouhém horském běhu
description: The World Masters Long Mountain Running Championships will take place on June 27, 2026, in the picturesque setting of Janské Lázně in the Hradec Králové Region. This race is intended for masters athletes and offers a challenging long mountain run that will test runners’ endurance and strength amid beautiful mountain scenery. The event is part of the prestigious trail-running calendar and attracts runners from around the world. For more information, we recommend checking the organization’s official website.

name: ROZKOŠný 1/2 Maraton
description: The ROZKOŠný 1/2 Marathon is a half marathon held in Česká Skalice, following a new cycle path around the Rozkoš Reservoir. The event offers a main 21.1 km race and an accompanying 2 km run for children and mothers with strollers. The event also features entertainment, refreshments, and the option of accommodation at the campsite, creating a pleasant atmosphere for participants and spectators alike. The main category starts at 12:30, and the first category starts at 10:00.

name: Běh lužanskými hvozdy
organizer: Obec Lužany, ELMAT Kůtek s.r.o., TJ Sokol Lužany
description: Běh lužanskými hvozdy is a traditional running race held in the recreational area of the village of Lužany near Jičín, specifically at the campsite by Marešák Pond. The 50th anniversary edition will take place on 27 June 2026 and offers a range of categories and race distances suitable for a wide variety of runners, including children. The race is supported by the Hradec Králové Region and organized by the Municipality of Lužany, ELMAT Kůtek s.r.o., and TJ Sokol Lužany. Participants can expect medals, prizes in kind, and cash awards for the top finishers in each category.

name: Žhavé běhy Slováckého léta
description: The Hot Runs of Slovácké léto are traditional running races held in the historic center of Uherské Hradiště. Participants can choose from three routes of 5, 10, and 21 kilometers, which pass through picturesque countryside along the Morava River, through Kunovský les forest park, and by the Novoveská lakes. The races are suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes, and offer a unique opportunity to enjoy running in the beautiful surroundings of Slovácko. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square, adding to the atmosphere of the city’s historic heart.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v běhu do vrchu - nahoru
description: The 2026 World Masters Mountain Running Championships in Janské Lázně is a prestigious international mountain running event for masters athletes, attracting competitors from more than 30 countries. The races take place on challenging courses with significant elevation gain, testing runners’ endurance and strength. The event is organised by TJ Maratonstav Úpice under the patronage of the towns of Janské Lázně and Úpice. Registration is open until 24 May 2026, and the event offers several course options of varying distances and elevation gains.

name: Sloupský lesní běh
description: The Sloup Forest Run is a traditional road race held in the picturesque surroundings of Sloup in the Moravian Karst. The course is 11.5 kilometres long and is characterised by significant elevation gain, making it a challenging and appealing race for runners. The event has a long history and attracts runners from the surrounding area, who enjoy the beauty of nature and the sporting atmosphere.

name: Lochovice - Plešivec
description: Lochovice–Plešivec is a running race in the Brdy Running Cup, taking place on June 28, 2026, in Lochovice. The course is approximately 5.5 km long with 350 metres of elevation gain. It starts with 2 km on asphalt, then continues along forest paths, with a steeper climb around the 3 km mark. The finish is at the summit of Plešivec, which offers beautiful views. The event also includes children’s races and a family run supporting the Mezi břehy home hospice.

name: Půlmaratón okolo Nového Veselí
description: The Half Marathon Around Nové Veselí is a traditional running race organized by AO TJ Sokol Nové Veselí, now being held for the 25th year. The main 21.1 km race follows a turnaround loop repeated three times on asphalt paths and third-class roads, with minimal elevation gain. Shorter races are also available for youth, school-age children, and preschoolers, making the event appealing to runners of a wide range of ages. Refreshments are provided after the race, and the winner of the main race receives a cash prize. The start is traditionally on the square in Nové Veselí.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Potůčky
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beautiful Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in various locations, including Potůčky, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km and the experience route covers 20 to 30 km. In addition to running, walking routes and children’s races are also available. The event is suitable for runners of all levels, canicross participants, children, and walkers, and offers the chance to discover the beautiful nature of the Ore Mountains.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Boskovická etapa
description: MUM – the Moravian Ultramarathon is an international stage race held in Boskovice and forms part of a seven-day ultramarathon covering seven marathons. The race is known for its difficulty and long tradition, attracting runners seeking the challenge of a stage race. The Boskovice stage gives runners the chance to experience the beauty of the Moravian countryside while testing their endurance on demanding terrain. The race is suitable for experienced ultramarathoners who want to compete against others in a prestigious international event.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - červen
description: Tempo Makers Osmicka is a running race in Plzeň with an 8 km course. The race is open to men and women aged 16 and over. The start and finish are at the same location, with registration and race number collection from 17:00 to 17:45. After the race, the top runners are presented with awards and a raffle is held. The race is limited to 75 participants, and each participant takes part at their own risk.

name: Lachtan
description: In Prague 6, Prague, the sea lion is primarily associated with the breeding and conservation of the South African fur seal at Prague Zoo. A theater performance called “The White Sea Lion” is also held here, aimed mainly at children and school groups, and offering interactive experiences with an environmental theme. The program is suitable for families and schools looking to combine education with entertainment and raise awareness of nature conservation.

name: Kolem Libotína
description: The Run Around Libotín is a traditional race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletics Club Kopřivnice and held in the area around Štramberk. The race features a challenging 6.5 km loop whose course was modified in recent years, resulting in new course records. The event is part of the Lašská Running League and attracts runners in various categories, who enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings and sporting atmosphere. Category winners are announced after the race, and a raffle is prepared for all participants. The Emil Zátopek Athletics Club Kopřivnice organizes the event and ensures its smooth running while supporting the running community.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Lomnická etapa
description: MUM – the Moravian Ultramarathon is an international stage race held over seven consecutive days, with the Lomnice stage as one of its parts. It is one of the most demanding ultramarathons in the Czech Republic, challenging runners with long distances and demanding terrain in the South Moravian Region. The race is intended for experienced ultramarathon runners who want to test their endurance and strength in beautiful countryside. The Lomnice stage takes place around Olešnice and Lomnice near Tišnov and is part of the full ultramarathon series.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Bystřická etapa
description: MUM – Moravian Ultramarathon is an international stage race consisting of seven marathons on seven consecutive days. The Bystřice stage is one part of the race, offering a challenging, long run in the picturesque surroundings of Moravia. The race is intended for experienced ultramarathoners seeking the challenge of long stages and beautiful nature. Come test your strength in this prestigious ultramarathon and experience the unique atmosphere of a stage race.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - červenec
description: The 2-Mile Run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, including children under 12, who run 1.6 km. The race is ideal for anyone who runs for fun, wants to improve their personal best, or simply enjoys a pleasant run in the beautiful surroundings of the park. After the finish, every participant is treated to a warm cinnamon pancake. The course follows the park’s paved paths; adults run two laps and children run one. Everyone is timed, and the results are published online.

name: Třtická punčocha
description: Třtická Punčocha is a traditional summer running race held in the village of Třtice since 1980, always on the first Sunday in July. The race is 8.8 km long and attracts runners from all over Bohemia. Originally intended for children, it now offers age- and gender-based categories for adults as well. In addition to the summer race, the village also hosts the 4.8 km Christmas Run, held on December 26. The races are popular and have a long-standing tradition, with results and photos archived on the village website.

name: Náchod - Dobrošov
description: Dobrošov Fortress is located near the town of Náchod, in the Kladské pomezí area of the Orlické Mountains. The fortress is an important part of Czechoslovakia’s northern border fortifications and offers visitors tours of its main bunkers, ammunition store, barracks, and infirmary. An educational trail runs through the fortress, taking visitors along the line of fortifications to the Běloves spa. The area around the fortress has numerous hiking and cycling routes, offering a chance to explore the beauty of the Orlické Mountains and nearby historic towns.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Cimrmanova etapa
description: MUM - Moravian Ultramarathon / Cimrman Stage is the seventh and final stage of an international stage race held in Lomnice near Tišnov. The race offers challenging and varied terrain with 740 metres of elevation gain, making it a test for experienced ultramarathon runners. The start is staggered according to the results of the previous six races, adding to the competition and suspense. This race is ideal for runners seeking a combination of technical challenges and stage racing amid the beautiful scenery of the South Moravian Region.

name: Širokodolská časovka
description: The Široký Důl Time Trial is a short interval running race held in Široký Důl near Polička and is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2026. The race takes place on an 800-metre asphalt course with 80 metres of elevation gain. Runners set off at one-minute intervals from 10:00. Registration takes place at the venue from 8:45 to 9:45. A cycling event follows the run but is not part of the running cup. The entry fee is a symbolic 50 CZK, making the race accessible to the general public.

name: Běh pod Slunečnou
description: Běh pod Slunečnou is an 8.3 km cross-country race held in Moravský Beroun in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix of Endurance and gives runners the chance to test themselves on natural terrain. The course is suitable for cross-country running enthusiasts and offers interesting natural scenery. The race is open to the general public and welcomes all runners who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and a challenge in beautiful surroundings.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Hlásná Třebaň
description: The Berounka Running Series in Hlásná Třebaň is part of a community trail race series held in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. The course passes through Karlštejn National Nature Park, with views of Karlštejn Castle, and offers runners varied terrain with forest paths and hilly sections. The race is suitable for all runners, whether beginners or experienced, and is part of a series of 12 races that encourage regular exercise and sporting activity. Refreshments, bag storage, and certificates for the top finishers in each category are provided on site.

name: 5. Běh pro zdraví
description: Run for Health is a charity running series organised by the TJ Jäkl Karviná athletics club, held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run is 3 km long and is open to everyone who wants to support their health while helping those in need, as the entry-fee proceeds are donated to charity. The start is traditionally at 17:45 by the Lodičky, with registration beginning at 17:00. Everyone is warmly invited to take part in this friendly, health-promoting run.

name: Běh okolo Bílé hory
description: The Run Around Bílá hora is a regular running race in Brno, offering a 1.7 km loop. Men and women run three loops, for a total of 5.1 km, while children can race over a distance adjusted to their age. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Bílá hora, near the playground, and is suitable for all age groups. The evening start is at 18:00, and runners can enjoy the community-run atmosphere, with refreshments and a place to store their belongings.

name: VUM – Valašské Ultramaraton – DEN1 – Zahřívání 🏃‍♂️

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: DEN1 - Zahřívání / DAY1 - Warm-up 999 Kč do / until 15.12.2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Všechny 3 tratě / All 3 Stages 2 099 Kč do / until 15.12.2026

description: VUM – Valašský Ultra Marathon is a demanding three-day stage ultramarathon in the heart of Valašsko and the Beskydy Mountains. The race is for runners seeking a challenge and discomfort, with progressively tougher stages that test physical and mental endurance. Each day is longer and more demanding, emphasizing self-sufficiency and the ability to recover. The race is not about speed, but about finishing safely and managing fatigue and decisions along the course. The organizers emphasize respect for nature and provide basic facilities, accommodation, and refreshments.
course_highlights: Three days, three stages with progressively increasing distance and elevation gain
Routes pass through the landscape of Valašsko and the Beskydy Mountains, including hiking trails, cycle paths, and forest roads
Maximum self-sufficiency for runners, with no conventional aid stations
additional: The entry fee includes camping in your own tent at the race venue, with the option of accommodation at a school (limited capacity). Refreshments during the race include coffee, tea, and basic refreshments before each stage, followed by fruit, vegetables, meat products, and sweet snacks after the stage. One liter of water per runner is available on the course at approximately the halfway point of each stage. Electronic timing and online runner tracking are provided. If exhausted, runners can use the organizers’ transport from the course. Every runner who completes at least one stage receives a finisher medal, while the exclusive finisher T-shirt is reserved for those who complete all three stages. The date differs between sources: the supplied date is July 11, 2027, while the event pages list July 9, 2027.

name: VUM Valašský ultramaraton
description: The Valašský Ultra Maraton (VUM) is a challenging three-day stage ultramarathon in the heart of Valašsko and the Beskids. The race is for runners seeking a challenge and discomfort, with progressively tougher stages that test both physical and mental resilience. Each day is longer and more demanding than the previous one, with an emphasis on self-sufficiency and the ability to recover. VUM is not a race for speed, but for endurance and safely completing all stages. The organizers emphasize respect for nature and runner safety.
course_highlights: Three days and three stages, with progressively increasing distance and elevation gain
Routes pass through the landscapes of Valašsko and the Beskids, including hiking trails, cycle paths, and forest roads
Maximum self-sufficiency for runners, without traditional aid stations
additional: The entry fee includes a participant pack with a cotton T-shirt, a race bib with your name or nickname, access to facilities with toilets and showers, accommodation in your own tent or at a school (limited capacity), refreshments before and after the stages, 1 liter of water on the route halfway through each stage, electronic timing, and online runner tracking. Every participant who completes at least one stage receives a finisher medal, while the exclusive finisher T-shirt is awarded only to those who complete all three stages. If you become exhausted, you can use the organizers’ transport from the course. This is not a team race, but you can run as a pair while competing as individuals. The race is self-supported: runners carry their own refreshments, and the course is not routinely marked, so navigating with GPX is mandatory. Approximately one liter of water per runner is available halfway through each stage. The ALL entry package includes access to facilities and the option of accommodation in your own tent or at a school.

name: Běhej lesy Klínovec
description: Běhej lesy Klínovec is a trail race in the Ore Mountains, taking place on July 11, 2026. The race offers various routes, including a short and a long course, as well as a charity race. The start is at the summit of Klínovec, with the option to take the cable car up before running down to the Klínovec Ski Area. The race is part of the international UTMB Index Races and features special speed sections, Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, with attractive prizes.

name: Libečovská 14
description: Libečovská 14 is a 14.2 km race with approximately 170 metres of elevation gain, running on both paved roads and trails. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup and offers runners an interesting mix of paved and off-road sections. The course is suitable for runners looking for a challenge with gentle climbs and varied terrain. The race takes place in the picturesque Podkozí area of the Central Bohemian Region and attracts runners from the wider area.

name: Králický Sněžník Beze stopy
description: Králický Sněžník BEZE STOPY is a challenging mountain run covering 14 km with 1,050 m of elevation gain. The route starts in Heřmanice and passes via Klepáč and Malý Sněžník to the summit of Králický Sněžník. It features beautiful ridge running with views of Poland’s Kłodzko Valley and the Dolní Morava valley, as well as short, demanding descents. The race is for lovers of mountain terrain and is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Iscarex Cup. Younger runners can take on a shorter 5 km course with 440 m of elevation gain. The main race starts at 9:30, and the junior race at 11:00.

name: Hvězdonice - Ondřejov
description: Hvězdonice–Ondřejov is a 5.75 km uphill race with 255 metres of elevation gain, starting in Hvězdonice. This running race offers challenging terrain and beautiful views in the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for runners looking for the challenge of an uphill course and wanting to test their strength in a mountain run. The race is part of the Svět běhu running calendar and attracts runners from a wide area.

name: S-Race
description: S-Race is an OCR race in Mariánské Lázně, held in front of the Ferdinand Spring Colonnade. The race offers 6 km, 12 km and 18 km courses, which run mainly along surfaced forest paths and feature more than 20 obstacles per lap. Age-group races are available for children. The start and finish are located right by the colonnade, with facilities including changing rooms, toilets, baggage storage and refreshments. The race is suitable for a wide range of ages and features staggered starts, with activities for children during the main race.

name: Koblížkový pasecký běh
description: The Koblížkový Pasecký Run is a traditional road race in Paseka near Olomouc, offering an 8.2 km course. The route runs on asphalt, paving stones and park paths, passing through the village, along the cycle path to the sanatorium and through the park of the Specialist Medical Institute, before returning to the start by the municipal office. The first categories start in the afternoon, creating a pleasant atmosphere for runners and spectators alike. The event is organised by Ivan Elischer, who ensures everything runs smoothly and supports the runners.

name: Halda Trail Run
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN is an off-road running adventure in Kuřimská Nová Ves, through the picturesque landscape of the Halda Stream valley and the Libochovka River. The longest route is approximately 24 km long and includes 23 stream crossings, all runnable and pleasantly refreshing in summer. The race offers three distance options (4, 14 and 24 km), which connect to one another and allow runners to change their distance during the race. The route runs mainly through forests and meadows, away from the main hiking trails, with panoramic views, two short, steep climbs and varied terrain—something both casual runners and ambitious trail runners will appreciate.

name: Běh o Ludgerův meč
description: The Run for Ludger’s Sword is the third edition of a running race organized by Běžecký klub Náchod in cooperation with the municipality of Hořičky. The race is part of the Primátor CUP running series and the Velká cena východních Čech cup. The routes pass through the area around Hořičky, offering beautiful views of the Kladské pomezí region. They run over gently rolling terrain on gravel and forest roads, with very little asphalt. Courses are available for children, as well as the 8 km main race and a 4 km FIT route. The start and registration take place at the complex by the football pitch in Hořičky.

name: Dvě kola při zdi
description: Dvě kola při zdi is a traditional cross-country race in Prague’s Hvězda Game Reserve, with courses for men, women, and children. Men run the 7.8 km main course along the reserve’s perimeter walls. Women have a shorter 4 km course, but can also run the men’s course. Two shorter loops are available for children. After the race, participants can enjoy a raffle and hearty refreshments.

name: Halda
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN is an off-road running race through the beautiful landscape of the Halda stream valley and the Libochovka River. It offers three routes of 4, 14 and 24 kilometres that connect to one another, allowing participants to change the distance during the race. The route runs mostly through forests and meadows, away from the main hiking trails, and features 23 stream crossings, two short, steep climbs and panoramic views. The race is suitable for both casual runners and ambitious trail runners, and is thoroughly marked with arrows and course ribbons.

name: Běh o Neplachovský Hrneček
description: The Běh o Neplachovský hrneček is a traditional running race held in Neplachov, South Bohemian Region. The 14th edition takes place on Friday, July 17, 2026. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is supported by the South Bohemian Region’s budget. The event offers a sporting experience in the region’s beautiful surroundings and attracts runners from across the wider area. The organizers warmly invite all runners to take part in this popular event.

name: Kružberský Tesák
description: Kružberský Tesák is a sporting event held at the Kružberk Reservoir grounds, offering routes and categories for experienced racers, intermediate participants, and complete beginners. The event is suitable for solo runners, hikers, and families with children. It also includes Pejskiáda, a fun show and competitions for dogs of all sizes and breeds. Organizers Kateřina and Lucie, nature lovers and dog-sport enthusiasts, aim to create a friendly atmosphere and ensure an enjoyable experience for all participants.

name: Zkus Noční Kuks
description: Try Noční Kuks, a night running race in the picturesque Baroque setting of Kuks. It offers two routes—10 km and 5 km—that pass historic landmarks such as Braun’s Nativity Scene and Kuks Hospital. Running in the dark, lit only by headlamps, offers a unique experience and atmosphere that runners will remember for a long time. The 10 km route includes the pilgrimage route of the 21st-century Stations of the Cross, while the shorter 5 km route runs along the Elbe at night and through the Count’s Alley, lined with 222 trees.

name: ČEZ RunTour Olomouc
description: ČEZ RunTour Olomouc is a family-friendly running event offering races for recreational and elite runners over 3, 5, 10 and 21.1 km, as well as children’s races of 500 and 1,000 metres. The event takes place in the picturesque setting of Smetanovy sady and is part of a nationwide series featuring unique courses. The organizers focus on excellent service, safety and fun for the whole family, with an accompanying programme and a charitable component. Every participant receives a race pack and can look forward to refreshments and support from the pacer team. ČEZ RunTour is not just a sporting event, but a full-day experience for all age groups.

name: Noční běh Rusava
description: Noční běh Rusava is an unforgettable night race in the Hostýnské vrchy, offering a 12-hour run on a single loop as well as a 5 km race. The race is suitable for both individuals and relay teams, and runners are not required to run for the full 12 hours. Race facilities include a gymnasium for resting, an all-night buffet, and aid stations. The event takes place amid the scenic ski slope and forests around Rusava, creating a unique sporting experience beneath the starry sky.

name: 7 pohoří Krušné Hory
description: The Krušné hory 2026 race is a technical trail run that takes you through the beauty of the Krušné hory mountains and the former mining landscape, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The route starts in Abertamy and passes the former Eva mine, Jelení, the Swiss Chalet on Plešivec, Merklín, the former settlement of Kaff, Pstruží and the ski area before reaching the finish. It offers three courses of varying lengths and elevation gains, appealing to both experienced runners and beginners. The race takes place in all weather conditions, and participants receive a commemorative medal and refreshments along the route and at the finish.

name: Rokytnice nad Jizerou - Dvoračky
description: The route from Rokytnice nad Jizerou to Dvoračky is a popular hiking trail in the western Krkonoše Mountains, starting at Horní náměstí in Rokytnice. The blue-marked trail follows the Huťský stream to the picturesque Huťský Waterfall and continues to the Dvoračky mountain lodge, known for its history and traditional cheese-making. The route offers beautiful natural scenery, especially in autumn, when the surrounding beech forests burst with color. It is suitable for hikers, ski mountaineers, and cross-country skiers, who can enjoy the snowy landscape and refreshments at the Štumpovka restaurant at Dvoračky.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Fojtovice
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. Across six races in different locations, you can choose from main races of 6 to 9 km, experience routes of 20 to 30 km, a walk with checkpoints to find, and children’s races. The series is suitable for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers, and offers a varied range of routes amid the picturesque scenery of the Ore Mountains. The Fojtovice race takes place on 19 July 2026 and offers a main race, an experience route, a walk, and children’s races.

name: Šachty - Štěpánka
organizer: Český Ski klub Vysoké nad Jizerou
description: Běh Šachty - Štěpánka is a traditional race organized by the Czech Ski Club in Vysoké nad Jizerou. The race is part of the Maratonstav Czech Cup in mountain running and offers runners a challenging course in the beautiful Krkonoše Mountains. The event attracts athletes and mountain-running fans, who can enjoy both the challenge and the atmosphere of a mountain race. The organizers welcome all runners who want to test themselves on this traditional course.

name: Běh za Sliveneckou saní
description: Běh za Sliveneckou saní is an uphill race in Prague 5–Velká Chuchle, covering 2.54 km with an elevation gain of 130 metres. The race is part of the Runs in the Hills of Prague and Surroundings series and challenges runners with a demanding climb. It is suitable for anyone looking to test their strength and endurance on hilly terrain.

name: 402. Malá cena Monaka
description: The Little Monaco Prize is a traditional running race organized by KRB Chrudim. It takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The race gives athletes the opportunity to test themselves on various courses and enjoy the atmosphere of the running community. The event is part of a long-standing tradition and attracts runners of all ages. The organizers emphasize quality event management and a friendly race atmosphere.

name: Tobiášův běh Kazín - Cukrák
description: Tobiáš’s Kazín–Cukrák Run is part of the KOPEC series, which features hill races in Prague and the surrounding area. This traditional race gives runners the chance to test themselves on challenging hilly courses in the picturesque surroundings of Kazín. The KOPEC series is known for its community atmosphere and support for runners of all categories, who are automatically included in the overall standings. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys running in nature and the challenges of hilly terrain.

name: Smilovice pomáhají - Běh pro Theu
description: Run for Thea is a charity race organized by the Smilovice Help Foundation, taking place on July 25, 2026, at the Sportcentrum Smilovice grounds. The race supports the treatment and rehabilitation of young Thea, who is facing serious health complications. Participants can choose from several routes of varying lengths and age categories, whether they want to race or simply take a walk. The event is open to everyone who wants to support a good cause and enjoy the pleasure of movement in a community atmosphere.

name: Běh na Lysou horu
description: The Run to Lysá hora is a traditional race held every year on the last Saturday in July in Krásná–Nižní Mohelnice. This 41st edition welcomes runners from the Czech Republic and Poland, all aiming to conquer Lysá hora, the queen of the Beskydy Mountains. The race starts near the Zlatník restaurant, at the crossroads leading to Lysá hora; registration and the awards ceremony also take place there. The course follows an asphalt road along a forest service road operated by Lesy ČR all the way to the summit of Lysá hora.

name: Borovská desítka
description: Borovská desítka is a traditional running race held in the picturesque village of Havlíčkova Borová in the Vysočina Region. The race offers a 10 km course with gentle elevation changes, running mostly through forest and along paved roads. The trees provide shade, making for a pleasant running experience even on sunny days. The start and finish are in the centre of the village, with aid stations along the course and at the finish. After the race, refreshments are provided, followed by an awards ceremony for winners in various categories.

name: Běh na Kozubovou
description: The Run to Kozubová is a traditional mountain race held in Dolní Lomná. It follows hiking trails over challenging elevation changes. The race starts by the bakery in Dolní Lomná and goes via Polana and the Pod Kykulou saddle to the tourist lodge on Kozubová. The course is approximately 5 km long, with around 500 metres of elevation gain, challenging runners with steep climbs and offering beautiful mountain views. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from juniors to veterans, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and generous prize raffle for participants.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka
description: The Emil Zátopek Golden Marathon is part of Zátopek’s Golden Week, a series of running races held in Plzeň in honour of Emil Zátopek’s Olympic victories. The main marathon takes place on 27 July and also offers accompanying races, including a half marathon, marathon and half-marathon relays, and a 10.5 km road race. The races start in the afternoon in Štruncovy sady and the surrounding area, with a varied programme and categories for men, women, and young people. The event is known for its tradition, high-quality organisation, and welcoming atmosphere for all runners.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - červenec
description: Tempo Makers Osmička is a regular running race in Plzeň, held along the Úslava River. The race is open to men and women aged 16 and over and offers a friendly atmosphere for all runners who share a passion for running and spending time together. The field is limited to 75 starters, making it an intimate and relaxed event. The start and finish are at the same location, with parking available nearby. After the race, the top finishers are announced and prizes are drawn in a raffle.

name: Krkonošská 50
location: Špindlerův Mlýn, areál Svatý Petr, Královéhradecký
description: Krkonošská 50 is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque setting of the Krkonoše National Park, starting in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race offers a challenging 50 km course with 1,784 metres of elevation gain, following marked paths and mountain trails. The field is limited to 300 starters, and the race is divided into several age categories for men and women. The organizers emphasize environmental responsibility and safety, including a requirement to carry a mobile phone and a ban on littering outside refreshment stations.

name: Běhej lesy Bílá
description: Běhej lesy Bílá is a mountain trail race held in the beautiful surroundings of the Beskydy Protected Landscape Area. The race offers several routes, including a short and a long course; the long ČSOB 20 km route is included in the international UTMB Index. Runners can take the cable car to the summit and look forward to the special Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which add extra competitive elements and rewards. The race is suitable for all mountain trail-running enthusiasts who want to experience the beauty of the Beskydy Mountains and compete on well-marked routes.

name: Zlatá stezka
description: The Golden Trail is a historic international hiking route connecting Bohemia with the Danube region. It winds through the beautiful landscapes of Šumava and the Bavarian Forest. At 631 km long, it offers a unique experience, linking up with Germany’s Golden Trail and passing through several national parks and nature reserves. Hikers can explore historic towns, castles, observation towers, and cultural landmarks along the trail, which is equipped with information boards and rest areas. The Golden Trail is ideal for hiking and discovering the region’s natural and historical attractions in the South Bohemian and Plzeň regions.

name: Běh na Kamenný stůl
description: The Run to the Stone Table is a traditional running race held in Rataje nad Sázavou, celebrating its 10th anniversary this year. The race offers a challenging and beautiful route from the castle courtyard to the Stone Table landmark, with varied surfaces and hilly terrain. It is open to professional runners, amateurs, and families with children, with shorter routes available for the latter. The race is part of the Běhej zámky series, which brings together running races at attractive locations near castles.

name: Mšecká sedmička
organizer: Městys Mšec a TJ Sokol Mšec
description: Mšecká sedmička is a traditional running race held in Mšec in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is 7 km long and follows forest and field paths, offering runners pleasant natural terrain. It starts at the TJ Sokol Mšec football field and is suitable for the general public. The event is organized by the Mšec Municipality and TJ Sokol Mšec, who ensure a friendly atmosphere and quality organization.

name: Libeř - Radlík
description: Libeř–Radlík is a 2.47 km uphill race with 170 m of elevation gain, part of the Runs in the Hills in Prague and Surrounding Areas series. The course is not entirely uphill: it includes several flat sections and one downhill, adding interest and variety to the race. The atmosphere is pleasant and the entry fee is symbolic, with generous prizes for the winners from Botanicus. The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain near Prague.

name: Trail Running Cup - Krkonošská padesátka
description: The Krkonoše Fifty is a traditional trail race held in the scenic surroundings of Špindlerův Mlýn in the Krkonoše Mountains. The race offers a challenging 50 km course with 1,784 metres of elevation gain, following marked paths and mountain trails. The start is at the Svatý Petr resort, and participants can use the central car park in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race is limited to 300 starters. Overall winners are named for both men and women, along with winners in ten age categories for men and women.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Moldava
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in different destinations, including Moldava, with routes for runners, canicross participants, children, and walkers. Each race offers a main running race of 6 to 9 km, an adventure route of 20 to 30 km using a map, a 5 to 8 km walk with checkpoints to find, and children’s races from 200 to 1,600 metres. The series is suitable for a wide range of people who want to explore the beauty of the Ore Mountains in an active and sporting way.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Karlštejn
description: The Berounka Running Series in Karlštejn is a community trail race held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Autokemp Karlštejn. The route crosses fields, meadows, and forests to the Malá Amerika quarry, continues along the red-marked St. James’s Way to Karlštejn Castle, and finishes with a downhill run to the finish line. The race offers a friendly atmosphere, a marked route, refreshments, and bag storage. Every participant receives a race number, and the top finishers in each category receive certificates and medals.

name: Rozdělovský čtvrtmaratón
description: The Rozdělov Quarter Marathon is a running race organized by Maratón klub Kladno and held in Kladno-Rozdělov. The club focuses on endurance running and organizing races in the region. The race offers runners of all levels an opportunity to test themselves over a quarter-marathon distance in the pleasant surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. The event is part of the club’s running calendar and supports the running community around Kladno.

name: Krčský lomcovák
description: Krčský Lomcovák is a traditional running race held in Krčský Forest in Prague 4. The race offers a 5 km course starting by the Velký altán, open to both men and women, with separate start times. The event is part of a fun sports afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, where participants and families with children can try various activities, such as slacklining, sack racing and disc golf. The race is organized by Krčák žije magazine, which covers activities and news from Krčský Forest and its surroundings.

name: Měřínský kros
description: Měřín Cross-Country Run is a traditional cross-country race through the beautiful Vysočina countryside. It offers a 13 km main race over Dědkovská hora and a relaxed 8 km course suitable for recreational runners. Children aged 5 to 12 can take part in the Junior Cross obstacle race, which features a giant bouncy castle.
