The race is timed using chip timing, and after the run there is an evening volleyball tournament with refreshments. The start and finish are at the sports field behind the primary school in Měřín, where parking, a baggage drop, toilets, changing rooms and showers are available.

name: Mořice Run
description: Mořice Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque village of Mořice near Olomouc. The race is part of a series of running events focused on recreational and competitive running, which the club organizes in Central Moravia. Liga stovkařů is known for supporting regular running and endurance races, and Mořice Run offers runners of all levels the opportunity to enjoy a quality race atmosphere. The club also provides support and advice to runners who want to get started or improve their training.

name: Slatinická sedmička
description: Slatinice Seven is a 7 km charity run that follows mostly off-road routes around the village of Slatinice near Olomouc. The race is dedicated to the memory of Šárka Krčková and offers runners a pleasant route surrounded by nature. The event is suitable for all runners who want to combine sport with supporting a good cause.

name: Vnorovská desítka
description: Vnorovská Desítka is a popular 10 km race held every year in August in the village of Vnorovy. The race is part of the Moravian-Slovak Running Cup and attracts over 200 runners from various countries, including Czech elite athletes and African runners. The course follows a closed asphalt loop with minimal elevation gain, with the start and finish at the elementary school. The atmosphere is lively, thanks to the large crowd and high number of participants; nearly 700 runners take part across all categories.

name: Černovírský kros
location: Černovír u Ústí nad Orlicí, Pardubický
description: Černovír Cross-Country Race is a traditional running event held in Černovír near Ústí nad Orlicí. Its hilly courses combine paved and unpaved forest and field paths with asphalt. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and adults. The start and registration are at the Sokol hall in Černovír, and the main race covers a distance of up to 5 km. The event has a friendly atmosphere and is popular with local and visiting runners.

name: Běh na Krušnou horu
description: The Run to Krušná hora is a traditional uphill race held in the village of Hudlice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race starts at the end of Dolejší Street by the forest and follows a wide gravel forest road to the Máminka lookout tower at the summit of Krušná hora. The course is 2.7 km long with 190 metres of elevation gain, offering runners a challenging but beautiful experience in nature. The event is organised by TOBI Sport s.r.o. and is part of the Czech Running Club.

name: Stezka mužů
description: Men’s Trail is a 3 km road race that is part of the SABZO series and will take place on August 12, 2026, in Prague 4. This race is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to spend time actively in a friendly atmosphere. Although the main focus is on running, the event is part of a larger sports and social program in the region. Come and race, and enjoy a day full of activity and fun.

name: 6. Běh pro zdraví
description: Run for Health is a charity series of seven runs held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run offers a 3 km route that everyone can complete at their own pace. Proceeds from the entry fee go to help those in need, giving the event purpose and added value. Registration opens at 17:00 and the run starts at 17:45 at Lodičky. Everyone is warmly invited to take part and support a good cause.

name: Reuter Run Boršov nad Vltavou
description: Reuter Run in Boršov nad Vltavou is a 12.5 km running race taking place on 15 August 2026 from 11:00 at Kemp Poslední štace. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and offers runners the chance to test themselves on an interesting course in the South Bohemian Region. The organiser is Zdeněk Richtr, and the race is suitable for a wide range of runners, including registered Cup members and other runners. The course surface is not specified in detail, but the race is part of a long-standing series with clear rules.

name: Běžecký mítink Bohuňovice
description: The running meet in Bohuňovice near Olomouc is a cross-country race offering men a 12.2 km course and women a 6.1 km course. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners and attracts runners who enjoy more challenging terrain. The meet is suitable for anyone who wants to test their strength in a natural setting with varied terrain. The event is a traditional gathering for the region’s running community.

name: 7 pohoří Šumava
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountains is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The races feature technical trails, epic views, and a unique atmosphere that will test every runner’s strength, willpower, and determination. Whether you’re an experienced mountain runner or a beginner, 7 Mountains challenges you to conquer every course and become a legend. The Šumava race offers routes that pass over the peaks of Špičák and Pacíř, around glacial lakes and through deep forests, with up to 900 m of elevation gain.

name: Jablonská osmička
description: Jablonská osmička is a running race in Jablonné nad Orlicí, held on 15 August 2026. This fifth edition features an 8 km main race, children’s races, and a fun beer relay for teams of four. After the race, the programme continues with a Food Festival and Jabloffest, featuring music and activities for children at the swimming pool grounds. The race is suitable for both athletes and recreational runners, and includes a generous raffle and gift bags for registered participants.

name: Křivinský kros
description: Křivinský Cross is a running race held in Křivice, featuring a 7.5 km main course with 275 metres of elevation gain and an 800-metre children’s course. The race runs mostly along forest roads and trails through hilly terrain, making for a challenging and interesting run. Starts are staggered from 9:30 a.m.: children go first, followed by juniors and then the main categories. The race is part of the East Bohemia Grand Prix and is open to the general public, with a voluntary entry fee. After the race, the results are announced and a short raffle is held for participants.

name: Žebrácká pětadvacítka
description: The Žebrák 25 is a traditional August road race on roads and forest trails in the Křivoklát region, held annually in Žebrák. It offers several distances, including the main 25 km race, a 10 km run, a 10 km walk, and a family run for children. The main race starts at 10:00 by the elementary school in Žebrák, while the senior categories start at 9:00. The event is part of the celebrations of the St. Lawrence pilgrimage fair and offers a wonderful sporting experience in the picturesque Křivoklát region.

name: MFB MarathOn LABE
description: MarathOn LABE is a traditional international running festival held in Kolín and Poděbrady, offering a marathon, half marathon, 10 km race, and other running events. The marathon course is an out-and-back route on forest, paved, and asphalt roads, certified by the Czech Athletics Federation (ČAS). The event is suitable for runners of all levels and features a rich program, including children’s races and family entertainment. It is organized by the Kolínská 14 association, which has supported an active and healthy lifestyle in the region since 2011.

name: Tyršův běh na Sokol
description: The Tyrš Run to Sokol is a traditional forest race in Malá Skála, offering a challenging 2 km course with 300 metres of elevation gain. The race is for nature-running enthusiasts who don’t mind hills and technical terrain full of roots, holes and rocks. Runners start at one-minute intervals, and the race has a long tradition; in 2021, it was held for the 36th time. Everyone interested in this type of race is warmly welcome.

name: Žvahov - Ivův běh
description: Žvahov - Ivův běh is a 3.7 km trail race held in the Děvín area of Prague 5. The race is part of the SABZO series and gives runners the chance to enjoy running in a natural setting, with gentle hills and interesting views. It is suitable for anyone who enjoys short but more challenging trail courses. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and test yourself against other runners amid the beautiful Děvín Hills.

name: ČEZ Lipno Sport Festival
description: The ČEZ Lipno Sport Festival is a traditional sporting event in Lipno nad Vltavou, offering a wide range of races for all ages and sports enthusiasts. The festival includes running races such as the Lipno Half Marathon, the 10 km COOP RUN and a family run, as well as cycling races, including 60 km and 20 km gravel and MTB routes. The event also features children’s races and evening runs along the scenic Čertovy proudy cycling path. Participants can enjoy the beautiful Šumava countryside and a varied programme of cultural activities.

name: Běh okolo Olympie
description: The Run Around Olympia is a running race in Brno, taking place on August 20, 2026, in the Chrlice area. The race features a 5.3 km loop, with men and women competing in a single category and starting together. A separate race is held for children, with the loop distance determined before the start. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant atmosphere, refreshments, and on-site baggage storage.

name: Šárecká 5
description: Šárecká 5 is a 5.3 km cross-country race held in the picturesque natural area of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6. This varied race gives runners the chance to enjoy a run in one of Prague’s most beautiful areas, with more challenging terrain. It is organized by SABZO Praha under the direction of Michal Procházka and is part of the Czech Athletics Federation’s running activities. The race is suitable for anyone who enjoys trail running and natural scenery.

name: Běh městem Strakonice
organizer: Město Strakonice, Okresní sdružení Česká unie sportu Strakonice
description: The 23rd Strakonice City Run is a traditional running race held on August 21 at the Summer Cinema in Strakonice. Runners of all ages can test themselves on 3.3 km and 6.6 km courses through the city. Both distances start together at 18:00. All participants have a chance to win prizes in a large raffle drawn from race numbers. Entries can be submitted by email or on race day.

name: Morava Run - proti proudu
description: Morava Run – Against the Current is a relay race that runs across Moravia along the River Morava. Teams consist of 7 to 12 members. The approximately 280 km route is divided into 30 sections of around 9 km, which teams allocate according to their abilities and strategy. The race starts in southern Moravia in the Soutok Protected Landscape Area and follows the river upstream through Slovácko, Haná and the Litovelské Pomoraví Protected Landscape Area to the source of the Morava on Králický Sněžník. The event is aimed at amateur runners and emphasizes teamwork and team building, with no pace limit.

name: Brdský půlmaraton
description: The Brdy Half Marathon is a traditional trail running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Kytín in the Central Bohemian Region. The race offers two routes: a more challenging 21 km course with 430 m of elevation gain and a shorter 9 km course with 158 m of elevation gain. Both have refreshment stations. On the longer course, overall winners and age and gender categories are recognized, while the shorter course awards the fastest men and women overall. The race is part of the Trail Running Cup series and is suitable for those who enjoy running in nature, with beautiful views and varied terrain.

name: Hrabovský 1/2 a 1/4 maraton
description: The Hrabová Half and Quarter Marathon is a traditional running race held in Ostrava-Hrabová, offering half-marathon and quarter-marathon courses. The race is part of the Hrabová Cup and the Moravian-Silesian Running Cup. Participants receive medals, and refreshments, changing rooms, and an accompanying program are available. The start and registration take place at the TJ Sokol Hrabová sports field. The course runs through an urban setting with a pleasant atmosphere and is suitable for a wide range of runners.

name: Jesenický maraton
description: The Jeseníky Marathon is a legendary and challenging mountain marathon in the Czech Republic, held in the Jeseníky Mountains since 2009. The marathon and half-marathon follow the same course every year, but changeable weather and mountain terrain make it feel different each time. Runners traverse the ridge of forested mountains, passing springs, primeval forests, stone fields and peat bogs, creating a unique atmosphere and challenge. The Jeseníky Marathon is for experienced endurance runners looking to conquer the highest mountain range in Moravia and Silesia.

name: Běh na Svatý Hostýn
description: The Run to Svatý Hostýn is a mountain race held in Bystřice pod Hostýnem in the Zlín Region. Part of the Czech Hill Running Cup, it offers a challenging 5 km race with 422 metres of elevation gain, with most of the course on paved roads. The race is open to both experienced runners and the general public, attracting running enthusiasts from across the country. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and the beautiful surroundings of Svatý Hostýn.

name: Běh k Božímu hrobu
description: The Run to the Holy Sepulchre is a traditional running event held at Svatý Hostýn in the Zlín Region. It is part of the broader range of pilgrimage activities and sporting events at the site. The event features an uphill run finishing at the Holy Sepulchre and is an important part of the regional sporting calendar. Get ready to experience the atmosphere of this pilgrimage site and enjoy a sporting challenge in the beautiful surroundings of Svatý Hostýn.

name: Běh na Čupek
description: The Run to Čupek is a newly established race in Metylovice that has already attracted two hundred runners. The course is scenic and challenging, providing participants with an interesting experience. The race is part of the calendar of Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, and its future place on the schedule is eagerly anticipated.

name: Vavřinecký běh Moravským krasem
description: The Vavřinec Run through the Moravian Karst is a sporting event held in the village of Vavřinec in the South Moravian Region and is part of the District Running League. The event takes place on August 22, 2026, and offers various running categories suitable for the general public. It is an ideal opportunity for running enthusiasts who want to discover the beauty of the Moravian Karst and enjoy an outdoor sporting experience.

name: Slopenská desítka
description: Slopenská desítka is a traditional cross-country running race held in the picturesque village of Slopné near Luhačovice. The race offers a challenging course with varied terrain, including asphalt roads, steep climbs and descents through forest terrain. The start is located below the church and the finish is on the sports field, where a rousing crowd awaits the runners. The event is suitable for the general public, including junior categories and family relay teams. The race is part of the year-round Běhy Zlín series and the KRAKONOŠ Czech Mountain Running Cup.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Stříbrná
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in different locations, including Stříbrná, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km and the adventure route covers 20 to 30 km. In addition to the main races, there are children’s races and walking routes with map-based checkpoints. The event is suitable for runners of all levels, canicross participants, children, and walkers, and offers a beautiful natural setting in the Ore Mountains.

name: Běh pro Střížák
description: Běh pro Střížák is a traditional race held on Střížovický vrch in Ústí nad Labem, now in its 16th year. The course is a loop run three times, with one significant climb and descent; otherwise, it is gently undulating. The event also includes shorter children’s and youth races, making it accessible to the wider public. The race has an interesting story: the course passes through an area that was once threatened by a planned development, which was cancelled thanks to local residents’ opposition.

name: Běh Smetánkou
description: Běh Smetánkou is a 3.5 km trail race held in Prague 9 and part of the SABZO series. The race gives runners the chance to enjoy a run in natural surroundings on varied terrain. It is suitable for anyone looking for a short but dynamic race in a pleasant atmosphere. The race is a longstanding part of Prague’s running season and attracts runners from the surrounding area.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (9) – srpnový
description: VAŠE LIGA’s 5 km and 10 km races are a regular running series in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava. The races are suitable for runners of all levels, from beginners to pros, and personal records are often set here. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the opportunity to run a qualifying time for the Czech Championships. After the race, participants can get together and refuel at a local restaurant. The series is part of its 16th edition and rewards not only the top runners but also loyal participants.

name: Běh Modřanskou roklí - Memoriál Zdeňka Buriana
description: The Běh Modřanskou roklí – Zdeněk Burian Memorial is a 4 km race along a gently rolling course in the Modřanská rokle Nature Reserve in Prague 4. The race is part of the SABZO series and features a staggered start, allowing the event to run smoothly. The course is suitable for runners who want to enjoy a run in nature with moderate elevation changes. It is ideal for anyone looking for a short but technically interesting race in beautiful surroundings.

name: Beskydská sedmička
description: IMOS Beskydská sedmička is an extreme mountain marathon across the entire Beskydy Mountains, running from Třinec to Frenštát pod Radhoštěm. This demanding race is approximately 101 km long with 5,500 m+ of elevation gain. It is the Czech Mountain Marathon Championship for individuals and is open to both solo runners and pairs. The race starts at night at 23:00 from the athletics stadium in Třinec, and the finish line closes after 28 hours on Sunday morning. The race offers a unique experience of the Beskydy mountain landscape and well-stocked aid stations along the course.

name: Kácovský běh
description: The Kácov Run is a traditional running race held on the last Saturday in August in the picturesque Posázaví region. It offers three main routes—the Nineteen, the Ten, and the Loop—with varied terrain and elevation that will challenge both experienced runners and beginners. The start and finish are in the center of Kácov, with aid stations on the longer courses. The race is timed using chip timing and accompanied by a varied program, including children’s races and a raffle.

name: Cross Parkmaraton
description: Cross Parkmaraton in Krásná Lípa is a traditional race set in the picturesque surroundings of Bohemian Switzerland National Park. The hilly course runs mainly along forest trails, with beautiful views of the Lužické Mountains. The event offers a range of disciplines, including a marathon, half marathon, shorter runs, Nordic walking, canicross and relays. It is suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts of all ages. In 2019, it received the Bohemian-Saxon Switzerland Regional Product certificate as a certified experience.

name: Chomutovský půlmaraton
description: The Chomutov Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque town of Chomutov in the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race offers a fast and scenic course through the town’s historic center, past the unique Kamencové Lake and beautiful natural areas such as Bezruč Valley. The event also includes children’s races and relay races, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. Participants in the main race can look forward to refreshments along the course and at the finish, as well as a finisher’s medal.

name: Běhej lesy Jizerská
description: Běhej lesy Jizerská is a trail race held on August 29, 2026, in the picturesque Jizera Mountains in Bedřichov. It offers various routes, including short and long distances and an ultramarathon, passing through beautiful natural locations such as Hřebínek, Smědava, Jizerka, and Olivetská hora. The race is part of the Běhej lesy series and is included in the UTMB Index Races, offering international ranking points. Runners can also take part in the Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which add extra competitive elements and prizes.

name: Proběhni si Zoo Ústí nad Labem
description: Run through Ústí nad Labem Zoo is a running event held on the grounds of the zoological garden in Ústí nad Labem. The run offers a unique opportunity to combine sporting activity with a visit to the zoo and admire the animals in their natural surroundings. The event is suitable for all age groups and encourages active leisure time in nature. We look forward to your participation and sharing an experience in the beautiful setting of the zoo.

name: Běh teplickými skalami
description: The Run through the Teplice Rocks is a public trail race held every year on the last Sunday in August in Teplice nad Metují. The race dates back to 1994 and is part of the sports program of the International Mountaineering Film Festival. The 9 km course follows the Metuje River to the rock city, includes sandy sections and stairs, and returns along the same route. Since 2011, the event has also included a children’s race with age categories. The start and finish are at the TJ Slavoj football field.

name: Běh zámeckou zahradou
organizer: Tělocvičná jednota Sokol Lysá nad Labem
description: The Castle Garden Run is a traditional running race held in the castle park in Lysá nad Labem. The 62nd edition takes place on 30 August 2025 and is open to a wide range of participants, from preschoolers to seniors. The race offers a pleasant setting in a historic park and encourages sporting activity for all age groups. It is organised by T. J. Sokol Lysá nad Labem, which has long supported sport for everyone.

name: Běh Bezděkovem
description: Běh Bezděkovem is a traditional cross-country race covering approximately 9 km, held in the picturesque surroundings of Bezděkov pod Třemšínem. The course runs mainly along forest paths through hilly terrain with moderate elevation changes and includes a mix of paved and stony sections. The race starts at the hunting lodge and features a challenging climb with gradients of up to 7% that will test runners’ fitness. After this demanding section comes a final descent and a flat finish, giving runners a chance to show their speed. The event also includes children’s races, making it appealing to a wide audience.

name: Kolínská desítka
description: Kolínská desítka is a 10 km out-and-back race on paved roads and a well-maintained forest path around the Mirka Tučka sports stadium in Kolín. The race is part of the Kolín Grand Prix and offers runners a pleasant mix of paved surfaces and natural surroundings. It is suitable for all runners looking for a fast yet scenic run in nature. Come enjoy the race atmosphere and test yourself against other runners in the beautiful surroundings of Kolín.

name: Rakovnická 15
description: Rakovnická Patnáctka is a 15 km road race whose start alternates each year between the towns of Rakovník and Křivoklát. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup and offers runners the chance to test themselves on an attractive course in the beautiful surroundings of the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for all runners looking for a quality road race with a tradition and the atmosphere of a regional running cup.

name: Sázava - Lázek
description: Sázava-Lázek is an uphill race covering 7.9 km with an elevation gain of 375 metres. The course starts on asphalt and continues along field and forest paths, with the steepest climb near the finish. This race offers challenging and varied terrain for runners seeking a challenge in the natural surroundings of the Pardubice Region.

name: Běh okolo Hříšné Milady
description: The Run Around Hříšná Milada is a cross-country race near Česká Lípa in the Liberec Region, offering two distances of 12 km and 6 km. The route runs mainly along forest roads and hiking trails that are open to regular traffic. The race is part of the District Running League and is suitable for trail running enthusiasts looking for natural terrain with technical challenges. The main category traditionally starts at 11:45, making it easy for a wide range of runners to take part.

name: Běh Anny-Marie
description: The Anna-Marie Run is a race held in Prague 4, offering a 6.6 km course over mixed terrain through Milíčovský Forest and over an artificial hill. The event is organized by the SABZO Praha association and is part of its running series, attracting runners of all levels. The course includes both forest paths and paved sections, making the race appealing to different types of runners. The race takes place on September 2, 2026, and offers a unique opportunity to enjoy nature and a sporting atmosphere in Prague.

name: SOKOLOVSKÁ 12/24 RUN
description: Sokolovská 12/24 RUN is an endurance running race lasting 6, 12 or 24 hours, open to individuals, pairs and teams of four. The race takes place on an easy, gently undulating loop around the Michal Natural Swimming Area in Sokolov. It starts on Saturday, 5 September 2026 at 11:15. Camping accommodation with full facilities is available. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners and offers various age and team categories, with exchanges permitted in the transition area by the refreshment stand.

name: Běh kolem Světa
description: Běh kolem Světa is a traditional running event held in Třeboň, following a route around the Svět pond. Since its launch in 2012, the race has gained a loyal following and offers an attractive 11.7 km course that follows the Svět Nature Trail. The event takes place every September and is popular for its natural scenery and varied terrain, including dirt, mud, sand, grass, wooden footbridges, and sections of asphalt. The race is suitable for runners of all abilities, and entry can also be purchased as a Christmas voucher.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - září
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín’s Příluky district is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt loop. There is also an 800-meter children’s course. Every participant receives a warm cinnamon pancake at the finish as a reward for their effort. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration before the start and timing for all runners.

name: Podhostýnská 10
description: Podhostýnská 10ka is a running race held in Bystřice pod Hostýnem, offering 10 km and 5 km courses, as well as children’s races. The event takes place in the castle park and is part of the Běhy Zlín running series. It is suitable for the general public and runners of all ages who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in beautiful surroundings. The organizers emphasize tradition and high-quality race organization.

name: Běh Plzeňské teplárenské kolem Boleveckých rybníků
description: The Plzeňská teplárenská Run around the Bolevec Ponds is a traditional running event organized by Pro Sport Activities, offering races for children and adults in the picturesque setting of the Bolevec Ponds in Plzeň. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Youth Running Cup and is suitable for the general public, including the youngest runners. Entry is free, and the first 300 people to register will receive a voucher for refreshments. In addition to the races, there is a program for children and an autograph session with athletes.

name: Birell Večerní Běh na 10 km Praha
description: The Birell Prague Evening 10 km Run is a traditional night race offering a unique atmosphere as Prague’s streets light up. The race starts at dusk, giving runners the chance to experience the city’s beauty in an unusual light. You can take part individually or as part of a team and enjoy the magical nighttime atmosphere beneath the stars. The race is part of the RunCzech running series and attracts thousands of runners every year.

name: adidas Běh pro ženy 5 km Praha
description: Come and run the adidas Women’s 5K in Prague, the largest race created specifically for women. The 5 km course is suitable even for runners with no prior training, with a 50-minute time limit. Enjoy the unique atmosphere and the support of thousands of women at an exclusive race with no men on the course. Sign up with your friends and share the joy of running and solidarity.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - září
description: The 2-Mile Run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, including children under 12, who run 1.6 km. The race is ideal for those who run for fun, want to improve their personal best, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful surroundings of the park. After the finish, every participant receives a warm cinnamon pancake. Everyone’s time is recorded, and results are published online and count toward the annual Lívancový Cup.

name: Barokomaraton
description: Barokomaraton is the 19th edition of a cross-country race held in the picturesque town of Plasy and the valley of the Střela River. The race is intended both for experienced runners and for those who run for pleasure and want to enjoy the beautiful autumn scenery. Runners can expect routes along forest and field paths, with regular refreshment stations. The organizers are also preparing a cultural program, entertainment for children, and refreshments, making Barokomaraton an enjoyable day of sport and relaxation for the whole family.

name: Strážný nahoru a dolů
description: Strážný Up and Down is part of the ISCAREX Cup, a traditional series of running races in the Pardubice Region. The race offers a challenging uphill and downhill run in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Dobrouč. The organizers provide a great sporting atmosphere and facilities for all participants. The event is suitable for experienced runners and recreational athletes who want to try running on hilly terrain.

name: Lupenická dvanáctka
description: The Lupenice Twelve is a traditional running race in Lupenice, held for the 33rd year. The race offers a 12 km course with 98 metres of elevation gain, running entirely on asphalt and clearly marked. The start is at the Lupenice sports complex, and the race is part of the East Bohemia Grand Prix. All participants run at their own risk, and those under 18 must provide parental consent.

name: Jenštejnská pětka
description: The Jenštejn Five is an annual 5 km running race held in the village of Jenštejn since 2014. In addition to the main race, other running categories are also held, making the event accessible to a wide range of runners. It is a traditional sporting gathering in the Central Bohemian Region and offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in the picturesque setting of Jenštejn.

name: Zbraslavská Závist
description: Zbraslavská Závist is a trail uphill race that starts in Prague-Zbraslav near the former mini zoo and leads to the former Celtic hillfort at the top of Závist. The course is 3.5 km long with 190 metres of elevation gain, offering a challenging and interesting running experience. The race is suitable for athletes ready for a fast start and a demanding climb. It is organised by KOPEC, z.s., under the auspices of the Czech Athletics Federation, and is part of Prague’s traditional running calendar.

name: Vorkloster run (1. etapa)
description: Vorkloster Run is a stage race held in the picturesque foothills of the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands, amid the medieval atmosphere of Porta Coeli Monastery. The race features three stages of varying distances and profiles, from a fast, flat stage to more challenging hilly sections. It is organized by the experienced DálRunDál team in cooperation with the Porta Coeli Monastery Brewery, which adds to the authentic experience. The routes are carefully marked and run mostly away from traffic, offering beautiful views of the surrounding countryside and historic landmarks.

name: Ostrava City Marathon
description: The Ostrava City Marathon is the oldest marathon in the Czech Republic and a summer running festival full of fun for all runners. It takes place on 6 September 2026 in the centre of Ostrava, on Masaryk Square, and offers races for different ability levels, including a minimarathon, 10 km, half marathon and marathon. The event is for both competitive runners and recreational runners, and also includes a charity MiniMarathon. In addition to the races, a rich programme of activities will bring sport and culture to the city centre.

name: Podčerchovský kros
description: The Podčerchovský Cross-Country Run is a challenging cross-country race held on Babí hora near Chodov. It follows forest paths with several tough climbs. The longest loop is 2.5 km and is also suitable for runners wearing spikes. The race is open to all age groups, with various distances ranging from children’s races to the men’s main event. Results are announced shortly after the race, and winners receive medals and prizes, with cash awards also offered in the main category.

name: Běh na Lahti
description: We invite you to the 47th edition of the traditional Běh na Lahti running race, taking place on September 6, 2026, in Děčín. The race offers two courses: the main course is nearly 10 km long with 230 meters of elevation gain, passing the Kvádrberk viewpoint and continuing above the village of Ludvíkovice; the shorter course is just under 5 km long with 130 meters of elevation gain. The route runs through the forests above the sandstone canyon of the Elbe River, offering beautiful views and a challenging run. Check-in and registration take place at the start from 8:00 to 9:45. The race starts at 9:00.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - září
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque setting of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily against themselves. It also includes a cup competition, in which results are adjusted using an age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year. Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00, and winners are announced in each category.

name: Rychnov pomáhá během
description: Rychnov Helps Through Running is a charity race held in Rychnov nad Kněžnou, offering routes for children and adults in various age categories. The race takes place in early September and is known for its friendly atmosphere, accompanying program, and support for those in need. Every participant receives a race pack and a medal, while the best runners in each category win valuable prizes. The event also includes an autograph session and a fun quiz with prizes, contributing to a family-friendly atmosphere and community spirit.

name: Běh mezi mosty
description: The Run Between the Bridges is a charity sporting event organized by the Athelas Home Hospice and the Friends of the Stone Bridge in Písek Association. Reviving the tradition of the original race, it is for everyone who wants to support seriously ill patients and their families. Participants can run, walk, or make a symbolic contribution. The entry fee is a donation that helps provide care at home for those who can no longer run. The event takes place in Písek and offers a variety of routes, including children’s runs and family walks.

name: Jihlavský půlmaraton
description: The Jihlava Half Marathon is a traditional 21.0975 km running race held over two laps in the centre of Jihlava. The race is open to individuals, pairs and teams of four, and features an officially measured course with kilometre markers. The event also includes a Family Run and children’s races, which support a charity project for Filípek. The event takes place at the Český mlýn complex and offers quality facilities, chip timing and refreshments for runners.

name: Horský čtvrtmaraton Jablonné nad Orlicí - Suchý vrch
description: The Jablonné nad Orlicí–Suchý vrch Mountain Quarter Marathon is a mountain race taking place on 6 September 2026 in Jablonné nad Orlicí. The course climbs through mountain terrain to Suchý vrch and is part of the Czech Cup in Hill Running and the Krkonoše Cup in Hill Running. The race covers approximately 10 km with around 580 metres of elevation gain. The course challenges runners’ endurance and their ability to run on technical mountain terrain. Registration is available on site, and the race is intended for runners looking for a challenge in nature.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Srbsko
description: The Berounka Running Series in Srbsko is a community trail race run mostly along the Heart of the Bohemian Karst Nature Trail. The route starts at the railway station and passes over the Srbsko footbridge, by the Bubovice Waterfalls and through the Kačák Valley along the Berounka River to the finish. The race offers beautiful natural scenery, a friendly atmosphere, and on-site refreshments and storage for personal belongings. Each participant receives a race number, and the top three finishers in each category receive diplomas.

name: S kopečka do kopečka
description: The S kopečka do kopečka Run is a traditional endurance race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering runners the chance to test themselves on a challenging course in Olomouc. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix of Endurance Runners series and is open to both recreational runners and competitive athletes. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the running community in Central Moravia. The race is suitable for anyone looking to enjoy a run in beautiful surroundings and take on the challenge of hilly terrain.

name: Novostrašecký běh - Memoriál Vildy Šubrta
description: Novostrašecký běh – Vilda Šubrt Memorial is a traditional running race held in Nové Strašecí, featuring a 6 km course. The race takes place at the SK Nové Strašecí football stadium and in the surrounding area, on a mix of asphalt, field and forest paths. The main category is scheduled to start at 18:00. The race is suitable for the general public; adults pay an entry fee of 100 CZK, while children can take part for free. Online registration is available even on race day, making it easy to participate.

name: Geofyzikální běh
description: The Geophysical Run is a traditional running event organized by the Institute of Geophysics of the Czech Academy of Sciences. It takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Krč Forest in Prague 4. The event has a long history dating back to 1985 and offers a sporting experience in nature with a scientific background. It is open to the general public and combines physical activity with the popularization of geophysics and the natural sciences.

name: 7. Běh pro zdraví
description: Run for Health is a charity series of seven runs held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run offers a 3 km route that everyone can complete at their own pace. Proceeds from entry fees go to help those in need, giving the event purpose and added value. The start is traditionally at 17:45 at Lodičky, with registration beginning at 17:00. Everyone is warmly invited to take part and support a good cause.

name: Witzenmann Opavská míle
description: The Witzenmann Opava Mile is a prestigious one-mile (1609 m) running race that continues the tradition of the Stanislav Mikeska Memorial. The race is open to a wide range of participants, including professionals, amateurs, children, families, corporate and school teams, people with disabilities, and wheelchair users. It takes place in Opava and is supported by its presenting partner, Witzenmann Opava. The course record is held by Filip Sasínek, with a time of 3:55 minutes set in 2023. The race is held regularly and is one of the most significant running events in the Czech Republic.

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Liberec
description: The Night Run for Světluška in Liberec is a charity running event held on September 10, 2026, at the Vesec sports complex. Participants can choose between a 3 km course (1 lap) and a 6 km course (2 laps), with the run starting at 8:00 p.m. The entry fee is 500 CZK, half of which supports the Světluška project and half of which goes toward direct assistance for people with severe visual impairments. The event offers an accompanying program, including a concert, and race packs with a headlamp or sports headband for those who register early.

name: Běh Akátkami
description: Běh Akátkami is a regular running race in Brno-Židenice, with courses for men, women, and children. Men run 5.2 km (3 laps), women 3.6 km (2 laps), and children of any age have their own 1.6 km lap. The race takes place in the evening, with registration from 17:15 and the main race starting at 18:00. Refreshments and baggage storage are available after the finish. Participants compete at their own risk and can use public transport and parking nearby.

name: Prajzské kilo
description: Prajzské kilo is an ultratrail race through the Hlučínsko region, recalling the historic borders and stories of a region divided in 1742. The race offers three distances—30, 50 and 100 km—with different time limits and elevation gains. You’ll run through a landscape of old roads, chapels and field tracks, bearing the traces of history and the identity of local residents. The race counts toward the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup and also offers points for the UTMB Index and ITRA. Participants receive a unique medal and T-shirt, with refreshments along the course and at the finish. Childcare is available for the shorter distances.

name: Okolo Kolovrat
description: The Run Around Kolovraty is a traditional race that takes you through the beautiful surroundings of Kolovraty, including the neighboring municipalities of Uhříněves and Lipany, as well as part of Říčany. It offers 11 km and 21 km routes, with the shorter distance also available as a two-person relay. The routes run mainly along tree-lined field, meadow, and forest paths, promising a wonderful running experience in nature. The race is suitable for all runners looking to improve their time or set a personal course record.

name: ČEZ RunTour Brno
description: ČEZ RunTour Brno is a family-friendly running event held near the Brno Reservoir, offering courses for all ages, from children to experienced runners. Choose from distances of 500 m, 1 km, 3 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21.1 km). The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, excellent facilities, and activities for the whole family. Every participant receives a race pack and contributes to charity. ČEZ RunTour is an ideal opportunity for recreational and elite runners alike to enjoy running in the beautiful surroundings of the Brno Reservoir.

name: Běh na Boží horu
description: The Run up Boží hora is a traditional race in Ivančice, challenging participants to climb 109 steps to Boží hora. Runners set off individually at one-minute intervals, ensuring a smooth race. The event is part of the wide range of activities organized by the Ivančice Leisure Centre, which has a long tradition and the support of the city. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a unique sporting experience in an attractive setting.

name: Běh Kovohutěmi
description: Běh Kovohutěmi is a traditional running race held in Lhota u Příbramě since 1967. The event features a 12 km main course as well as races for children and young people. It takes place at the TJ Kovohutě stadium and is popular with runners of all ages. Every year, it attracts many participants and is part of the Brdy Running Cup.

name: Strojařská desítka
description: Strojařská desítka is a traditional road race in Zlín, now held for the 42nd year. The race offers 10 km and 5 km courses with 153 metres of elevation gain on a certified out-and-back route between Zlín’s Maják, the U Boudy crossroads, Salaš and back. The start is always at 10 a.m. by the headquarters of the Road Maintenance Administration on K Majáku Street. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all categories who want to compete in the beautiful surroundings of Zlín.

name: Běh přátelství Klenčí pod Čerchovem - Waldmünchen
description: The Klenčí pod Čerchovem–Waldmünchen Friendship Run is part of the Běžec Chodska running series, which offers a diverse range of races in the Chodsko region. The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Klenčí pod Čerchovem and attracts runners of all ages. The course is suitable for those who enjoy nature and trail running, while the race atmosphere encourages friendly gatherings among the running community. The Běžec Chodska series is known for its tradition and high-quality organization, ensuring an enjoyable experience for all participants.

name: Bezdězský půlmaraton
description: The Bezděz Half Marathon is a running race held in the picturesque Máchův kraj region around Bezděz Castle. It offers two routes of approximately 13.6 km and 21.2 km, with elevation gains of 200 to 300 metres, along forest roads, trails and short stretches of asphalt. The race is suitable for the general public and also includes children’s races. Refreshments, baggage storage, toilets, and an awards ceremony with a raffle are available at the venue. The field is limited to 500 runners, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and quality facilities.

name: 7 pohoří Krkonoše
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountains is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The races offer technical trails with epic views and an atmosphere you won’t find anywhere else. Whether you’re an experienced mountain runner or a beginner, 7 Mountains will test your strength, willpower, and determination. Conquer all seven mountain ranges and become a trail-running legend.

name: Běh k Mohyle Hanče a Vrbaty
description: The Run to the Hanč and Vrbata Cairn is a traditional mountain race held in the Krkonoše Mountains. It starts at the White Bridge over the Elbe in Špindlerův Mlýn and finishes at the Hanč and Vrbata Cairn. The 9 km route, with 696 metres of elevation gain, runs mostly on asphalt and trails, offering beautiful views and unforgettable experiences. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners across different age categories. After the race, refreshments and a raffle are available, and public transport can be used to return from the finish.

name: Okolo Muňáku
location: Munice u Hluboké nad Vltavou, Jihočeský
description: Okolo Muňáku is a family running race in Munice near Hluboká nad Vltavou, offering a relaxed atmosphere and a fast course around Munický Pond. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is open to all age groups, including children’s races. Each edition supports the charity Centrum Bazalka, which receives part of the entry fees. After the race, there is a varied program, including a raffle and prizes for the fastest runners.

name: Vrchlabský 1/2 Maraton
description: The Vrchlabí City Half Marathon is the inaugural edition of the half marathon, held in the heart of the Krkonoše Mountains at T. G. Masaryk Square in Vrchlabí. During the race, participants can enjoy a sporting challenge on asphalt roads, field paths and forest trails, as well as a cultural programme and a friendly atmosphere. In addition to the main half marathon, shorter 2 km and 9 km routes are available for children, juniors and families with children, taking them through the town and its side streets. The event brings together running, experiences and community, and is co-funded by the State Environmental Fund of the Czech Republic.

name: Forestova čtrnáctka
description: Forestova čtrnáctka is a 14 km running race around Záluží near Plzeň, featuring a mix of field, forest, and gravel roads with light trail terrain. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children and young people, who can enter for free. Runners can look forward to plenty of refreshments, a participant medal, and race photos. Registration opens at 9:00, and the start is scheduled by 9:45. The race takes place in all weather conditions. The organizer emphasizes participant safety and fitness to compete; runners take part at their own risk.

name: Králický Lískovec
description: Králický Lískovec is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Lískovec hill and its vicinity in Králíky, Pardubice Region. The race offers various distances, from short children’s categories to the 8 km main race, which is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The main race starts at 11:30, while the children’s categories start from 10:30. The race is suitable for the general public and prizes are awarded to winners in each category. Registration is available on-site on race day from 8:00 to 9:45.

name: Kokořínský kros
description: Kokořín Cross is a trail race held amid the picturesque scenery of the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, not far from Prague. The race offers three main routes of 15 km, 10 km and 5 km, which pass through romantic ravines and by unique sandstone towers. The start and finish are located in the municipal spa complex in Mšeno, which provides facilities including refreshments and a children’s corner. The race is suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes, and offers a wide range of categories, with the option to change route distance even on race day.

name: Hostivařská 15°
description: Hostivařská 15 is a family-friendly trail race in the natural surroundings of Prague’s Hostivař district, offering more than just a test of performance. The race takes place around the reservoir, golf course and meanders of the Botič River, with mostly forest trails and very little asphalt. There is no timing equipment at the start; the winner is the runner who estimates their time most accurately. The atmosphere is outdoorsy and brewery-themed, and the event is suitable for all ages, including children.

name: 4Drun
description: 4Drun is a traditional running race organized by Sportovní klub DDsport, z.s., held in the picturesque surroundings of Dubany near Prostějov. The race offers a 10.2 km course through the area around Dubany, neighboring villages, and nearby cycle paths, combining asphalt and cross-country sections. The program also includes a 2 × 5 km relay, a 4 km family run, and children’s races, making the event suitable for all age groups. A varied program of accompanying activities is planned for race day, and every participant receives a commemorative medal.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - září
description: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli is a regular 8 km running race held in the pleasant surroundings of Plzeň. The race is for all runners who share a passion for running and spending time together. The start and finish are at the same location, with parking available for participants. The event offers a friendly atmosphere and is suitable for various age groups.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (10) – zářijový
description: The 5 km and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY is a regular running series in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava where personal bests are often set. The races are part of the 16th edition and are suitable for runners of all levels, from beginners to pros. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the chance to meet the qualifying time for the Czech Championships. After the race, participants can get together and refuel at a local restaurant, adding to the relaxed running atmosphere.

name: Podzimní běh okolo Europlantu
description: The Autumn Run around Europlant is a traditional running race held in Prague’s Horní Počernice district. The race is 7.5 km long and combines paved and off-road sections. It starts in the early evening, with slower runners setting off earlier. The event is open to all runners and is supported by Prague 20. After the race, participants are rewarded with potatoes provided by the sponsor, Europlant.

name: Běh proti násilí
organizer: Asociace pro práci s lidmi, kteří se dopouštějí násilí z.s.
description: Run Against Violence is a traditional charity run held in Hvězda Game Reserve in Prague 6. It supports the Stop Violence program and clients taking part in long-term therapies focused on managing anger and aggression. The run brings together participants of all ages who want to show their support and offer hope to those trying to change their behavior. The 5 km course is suitable for anyone who wants to support a good cause while enjoying exercise in nature. The event is organized by Diakonie ČCE, a major provider of social services in the Czech Republic.

name: Běh pro hospic Červený Kostelec
description: Run for Hospice is an open charity race held in Červený Kostelec, with courses for all age groups. The race takes place on September 19, 2026, and includes children’s courses along a forest path, as well as 2, 5 and 10 km courses over rolling mixed terrain, mostly asphalt with some forest and field paths. The event is part of the Primátor CUP running series and supports hospice services provided by the Červený Kostelec Regional Charity. Participants can enjoy the pleasant countryside around the Kostelec ponds, with views of the surrounding mountains.

name: Zátopkova 10
description: Zátopkova 10 is a traditional running race held in Lomená Alej in Stará Boleslav. The course consists of two five-kilometre loops along forest trails. The race is part of the Trail Running Cup 2026 series and offers a 10 km main race, a two-runner relay, and children’s races over 500 and 1,000 metres. The course is mostly flat, and the start is staggered, with an on-course refreshment station. Runners receive a race number with a timing chip, a commemorative medal, and additional services including refreshments and photos from the course.

name: Li.T.R. – Lipno.trail.run.
description: Li.t.r. is a weekend trail festival featuring a 108 km main race with over 2,000 metres of elevation gain around Lipno. The run offers a unique opportunity to discover the little-known Lipno region, its history and its stories during a demanding ultratrail. The race is open to both solo runners and teams, and is complemented by a programme of activities from Friday to Sunday. The atmosphere is friendly and community-focused; the event is organised by runners for runners, with respect for nature and local culture.

name: Mattoni Running Festival Ústí nad Labem
location: Ústí nad Labem, Mírové náměstí, Ústecký
description: Mattoni Running Festival Ústí nad Labem 2026 is a traditional running race with a fast, flat course that follows the Elbe River and passes the local chemical plant. This half marathon is known as the “Ferrari among races” for its speed and the records that are often set. During the race, runners can enjoy beautiful views of the Bohemian Central Highlands and Střekov Castle. The festival offers various running events, including a half marathon, a half-marathon relay, a 10 km race, and family runs.

name: Mladé Běchovice
description: Mladé Běchovice is a traditional running race for children aged 1 to 18, held on a grass field in Prague-Běchovice. The race offers courses of varying lengths, from 50 to 1,300 metres, to accommodate participants across a wide age range. Around 800 children take part each year, making it a significant sporting event for young runners. In 2026, the popular race will be held for the 61st time.

name: Běh Moravským krasem
description: Run through the Moravian Karst is part of the Blansko District Running League, which dates back to 1976. The race gives runners from the Blansko area and beyond the chance to test themselves in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Moravian Karst. It is suitable for the general public and forms part of a year-round competition that promotes running in the region. The organizers aim to provide quality services and a welcoming atmosphere for all participants.

name: Litovelská nealkoholická čtrnáctka
description: Litovelská Non-Alcoholic Fourteener is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque town of Litovel in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of a running series and offers an opportunity for recreational and competitive runners alike. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the running community in central Moravia. The race is suitable for the general public, and its name—which refers to the event’s non-alcoholic nature—also reflects its friendly atmosphere.

name: Podzimní běh Heřmanův Městec
description: The Autumn Run in Heřmanův Městec is a traditional running race held in a beautiful castle park. It offers two main distances, 5 km and 10 km (two laps), as well as children’s races in the start and finish area. The race is part of the Vládce Mrdic sports league and attracts runners of all ages who enjoy the pleasant autumn atmosphere and excellent facilities.

name: Hořovický cvoček
description: Hořovický cvoček is a traditional running race held in Hořovice, offering a course approximately 12 km long. The route follows forest paths and paved roads, starting on Valdecká Street by the water tower and heading towards Hvozdec. The main race starts at 10:00 and is for adult runners, with no children’s categories. The entry fee is 150 CZK with pre-registration and 200 CZK on the day. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup and has a long history, with results and statistics available.

name: Kačina Run
description: Kačina Run is a running race held in the beautiful grounds of Kačina Castle and its expansive park. It is part of the BĚHEJ ZÁMKY STŘEDNÍ ČECHY series. The race offers courses for children of up to 800 metres and 5 km and 10 km courses for adults, running mostly on gravel and forest paths. The event is suitable for anyone who enjoys exercise and nature, and offers a friendly atmosphere with refreshments along the course and at the finish. The start and event facilities are located behind Kačina Castle, where registration and the awards ceremony also take place.

name: Leskros Mácháč
description: Leskros Mácháč is a new event this season, with beautiful routes ideal for running and canicross in the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, not far from Lake Máchovo. The routes follow soft sandy trails covered with pine needles, making for a pleasant running experience in a natural setting. The event offers a range of distances, from children’s races up to 21 km, including running, canicross, walking/running, and dog trekking categories. Race facilities include refreshment stations for people and dogs, massages, taping, and canine physiotherapy advice, helping all participants feel at ease.

name: Štramberský Jasoň
organizer: Spolek Bezva běh pro bezva lidi z. s.
description: Štramberk Jasoň is a traditional hiking march and running event taking place on September 19, 2026, in Frýdlant nad Ostravicí and the surrounding area. It offers 22 routes of varying lengths, from 6 km to 67 km, including both race and hiking options. Participants can choose routes passing through Lysá hora, the Palkovické hůrky, Velký Javorník and other scenic locations in the Moravian-Silesian Region. At the finish in Štramberk, all registered participants receive an original medal and can order a printed T-shirt. The event is suitable for a wide range of participants, including families with children, and also offers routes suitable for strollers and seniors.

name: Havlíčkova pětka
description: Havlíčkova Pětka is a running race of approximately 5.2 km, running mainly along cycle paths and pavements beside the Sázava River in Havlíčkův Brod. It is suitable for those who do not have a relay team or find a half marathon too challenging. The race starts from Havlíčkovo Square, and part of the entry fee goes toward supporting sports equipment for young people. The race is part of the Běžec Vysočiny running cup and offers refreshments at both the start and finish.

name: Běh rodným krajem Emila Zátopka
description: The Run Through Emil Zátopek’s Native Region is a traditional race dedicated to the legacy of the famous Olympic athlete Emil Zátopek. It is held each year on the Saturday closest to his birthday, 19 September. The race starts in his hometown of Kopřivnice, by the statue of Emil Zátopek, and finishes at the Wallachian Open Air Museum in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm after a challenging 22.3 km course with a hilly profile. The race is open to participants aged 15 and over and also offers accompanying runs for children and the public. After the race, the winners are ceremonially presented with awards in the presence of distinguished guests.

name: Kocelovice-Hornosín-Kocelovice
description: The Kocelovice–Hornosín–Kocelovice cross-country run is a traditional sporting event organized by the municipality of Kocelovice in the South Bohemian Region. The run takes place on Saturday, September 19, 2026, and participants can expect a route from Kocelovice to Hornosín and back. The event is suitable for running enthusiasts and anyone looking for an active day out in scenic terrain popular with hikers and cyclists. The start and finish are by the former school building in Kocelovice, where the race is also organized. The event lasts approximately four hours.

name: Havlíčkobrodský půlmaraton
description: The Havlíčkův Brod Half Marathon is a traditional running event held in Havlíčkův Brod, celebrating its 14th edition in 2026. The main half-marathon course follows public cycle paths and sidewalks, mostly along the Sázava River, and passes through Havlíčkův Brod Square. The event also includes children’s races, relays, and the shorter Havlíčkova Pětka, making it accessible to the general public across a range of age groups and ability levels. The race offers quality facilities, refreshments on the course and after the race, professional timing, and a rich accompanying program.

name: Běh pro Hospic Anežky České
description: The Run for Anežka Česká Hospice is an open charity race held in Červený Kostelec, offering courses for all age groups. The race takes place on September 19, 2026, and includes children’s courses along a forest path, as well as 2, 5 and 10 km courses over rolling mixed terrain, mostly on asphalt with some forest and field paths. The event is part of the Primátor CUP running series and supports hospice services. Race numbers are distributed from 8:15, and the main race winners are announced at 12:00.

name: Jilemnice - Žalý
description: Jilemnice–Žalý is a hill race with a total elevation gain of 569 metres, held in the picturesque surroundings of Jilemnice in the Liberec Region. The race is part of the Czech Hill Running Cup and features a challenging 9.5 km course. The start is in Jilemnice’s town square, and the race is suited to runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain. It is organised by ČKS SKI Jilemnice, z.s., which provides professional organisation and support for participants.

name: Soběchlebský Š-krpál
organizer: místní běžečtí nadšenci ve spolupráci s obcí Soběchleby a SDH Soběchleby
description: Soběchlebský Š-krpál is a traditional running race held in the area around the village of Soběchleby since 2017. The main course is approximately 11.7 km long, with 268 m of elevation gain, and runs 90% on unpaved farm and forest roads. Since 2024, the event has also included a 6 km fitness run, suitable for beginner runners and walkers. The start and finish are at the football pitch in Soběchleby, which has facilities including changing rooms, showers and refreshments. The accompanying programme includes children’s races for various age groups.

name: Černošický běh
description: The Černošice Run is a traditional race held in Černošice, offering routes for different age groups, from the youngest children to adults. The event takes place at the sports field at the end of Husova Street and includes short children’s races, a family relay, and longer routes for adult runners. Starts are staggered from 14:00 to 15:40, allowing participants of different age groups to take part comfortably. The event is suitable for families and runners looking for a sporting challenge in a pleasant town setting.

name: Trail Český ráj
description: Trail Český ráj is a popular trail half marathon that takes you through the heart of Český ráj, including the courtyard of Kost Castle, pine groves and sandstone cliffs. This race continues the popular ELEVEN PŮLMARATON ČESKÝ RÁJ, now in its eleventh edition, and offers what is probably the most beautiful trail half-marathon course in the Czech Republic. The start is by Komárov Pond, and the finish is a reward for every runner. The race also offers runners a wide range of services, including refreshments, changing rooms and medical assistance.

name: PoHodová devítka
description: PoHodová Devítka is a traditional running race in Velká Bíteš, held in September after the local festival. The main course is 9 km long and suitable for all runners, while children can compete on shorter courses. The race offers a friendly atmosphere and is open to the general public, with categories for children and youths. About one third of the route is on asphalt and two thirds on unpaved roads. The race takes place amid normal road traffic, and each participant runs at their own risk.

name: Memoriál Matěje Mauera
description: The Matěj Mauer Memorial is a 9 km running race that runs mostly along forest trails, with one longer climb. The race takes place in the picturesque Capartice area near Plzeň and is part of the Běžec Chodska series. It gives runners the opportunity to test themselves in a natural setting on a more challenging course. It is suitable for runners seeking a trail challenge and the atmosphere of a traditional race.

name: 404. Malá cena Monaka
description: The Little Monaco Prize is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The race has a long history and is part of the KRB Chrudim club’s running calendar. It offers a sporting atmosphere and an opportunity to test yourself on an interesting course in beautiful surroundings. It is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels.

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Zlín
description: The Night Run for Světluška in Zlín is a charity running event held on September 24, 2026, at náměstí Míru. The start is at 8:00 p.m., and participants can choose a route to suit them or walk it. Entry packages are available in two options—with a headlamp or a sports headband. Part of the entry fee goes toward helping people with severe visual impairments, underscoring the event’s charitable nature. There is also an accompanying program for all participants.

name: Běh okolo Campusu
organizer: Běžecký spolek z.s. a Sportuj s námi, z.s.
description: The Run Around Campus is a running race in Brno, held in the Bohunice district. The race features a 5.6 km loop, with men and women competing in a single category. The program also includes a children’s race for children of any age, with the loop length determined before the start. The event is friendly and open to all runners, offering a chance to discover interesting places in Brno.

name: Eleven Večerní běh
description: ELEVEN Evening Run is a 5 km night race held in the early evening at the VOLT brewery grounds in Jablonec nad Nisou. The route runs around three reservoirs and is suitable for men, women and young people aged 16 and over, as well as children up to 15 years old. The race offers a sporting atmosphere, chip timing and valuable gifts for the first participants to register. The start and finish are at the brewery grounds, where race numbers can also be collected.

name: Běh Březinou v Polné
description: The Březinou Run in Polná is a traditional running race organized by Běžecký tým Polná and Běžec Vysočiny z.s. and held at the football stadium in Polná. The race offers courses for different age categories, from the youngest children to veterans, with the main 9.5 km race following field and forest paths through the valley of the Šlapanka River. The race starts at 17:00, and participants can expect a pleasant atmosphere and commemorative prizes for the top finishers in each category. The race has a long tradition, with more than 39 editions since 1992.

name: Mělnický vinařský běh
description: The Mělník Wine Run is a traditional running race in Mělník, offering 10 km and 21 km courses. The race takes place on a single loop with beautiful views of the castle and vineyards, and the route passes historic and natural attractions in the surrounding area. After the finish, participants can enjoy a tasting of local wines, a commemorative glass, a free lunch, and a large prize draw. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own free races. The event is organized by the Run the World association, which promotes running as a friendly community activity.

name: Grymovská pětka
description: Grymov Five is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, offering athletes the chance to test their abilities in the pleasant surroundings of the town of Grymov. Liga stovkařů Olomouc is a club specializing in recreational and competitive running that organizes a number of endurance races in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of its running calendar and attracts runners of various ages and ability levels. The club also supports runners with training and race preparation, ensuring a high-quality sporting experience.

name: Běh Bohutínem
description: Běh Bohutínem is a traditional running race organized by SK Sporting Bohutín and held at the Litavan football pitch. The race offers an 8 km course for men and a 4 km course for women, with a surface combining asphalt and forest trails. The event also includes children’s races, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. The main race starts at 13:00, and the atmosphere is friendly and sporty.

name: Běh Zlínského kraje
description: The Zlín Region Run is part of the Zlín Region Day celebrations, taking place on 26 September 2026 in Zlín. The event offers not only a sporting experience in the form of a 6 km run, but also a cultural programme, regional cuisine and family activities. The run is open to the general public and is part of a fun-filled day featuring crafts and regional products. The event is organised by the Zlín Region, which supports sport and local traditions.

name: Běh Velké skály
description: Běh Velké skály is a traditional running race held in Děčín, offering 11 km and 6.5 km courses through forest and urban terrain. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup and is suitable for the general public, including children, for whom special races are held. The race starts at the ASK Děčín athletics stadium, and its atmosphere is enhanced by the beautiful surrounding countryside and rock formations. The race is now in its 56th edition and is known for its exceptional atmosphere and high-quality organization.

name: Plzeňský kardioběh
description: The Plzeň Cardio Run is Plzeň’s largest cross-country race, with 5.8 km and 10 km courses. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Youth Running Cup and also serves as the Czech Republic Cross-Country Championship for healthcare professionals. It is organized by Pro Sport Activities, an agency with a long-standing tradition of organizing sporting events in Plzeň and the surrounding area. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a quality sporting experience in the natural surroundings of Plzeň-Roudná.

name: 7 pohoří Beskydy
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountain Ranges is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The Beskydy race takes place at the Horečky amphitheatre in Trojanovice and offers technical trails, epic views and an atmosphere you won’t find anywhere else. The routes follow forest roads and paths, with climbs up interesting hills and long descents. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and can look forward to refreshments and professional facilities.

name: ŠumpeRUN
description: ŠumpeRUN is a popular city race through the historic center of Šumperk. The eighth edition offers races for the general public, including the main 10 km race, a 3.33 km race, three-person relay teams, and children’s races of various lengths. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and community spirit while celebrating the city’s cultural heritage. For 2026, a varied program of activities is planned, including group warm-ups and music along the course.

name: K3-run
description: K3 – the Krčmaň Run over Three Peaks is an 11.3 km race with approximately 350 metres of elevation gain. The route passes through beautiful countryside over three peaks, mainly on paved paths and partly on grass, with predominantly firm surfaces. This run offers athletes an enjoyable experience in nature and a challenge in the form of climbs and trail running.

name: Běchovice - Praha, MČR v silničním běhu mužů, žen, juniorů a juniorek
description: Běchovice–Prague is a legendary 10 km road race with the longest unbroken tradition in Europe, now being held for the 130th time. The race is the official Czech Republic Road Running Championships and features a challenging 10,031-metre course that will test every runner. The exceptional atmosphere is complemented by modern facilities, including an accompanying programme and commemorative medals. The race is open to a wide range of categories, from juniors to veterans, and also offers a relay race.

name: Běh metropole Praha 1
description: Běh Metropole is a series of public running races held in various districts of Prague. Its aim is to promote a healthy lifestyle and a sense of belonging among residents of their district. The race is open to all age groups, from children to seniors, as well as people with disabilities, who represent their district. Every start earns points in the competition to determine Prague’s most sporting district. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with original medals and gifts for participants.

name: Svatováclavský běh Blažovicemi
organizer: Spolek přátel Svatováclavského běhu - sdružení Vévoda
description: The St. Wenceslas Run through Blažovice is a traditional cross-country and trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Blažovice in the South Moravian Region. It offers two main routes of 10 km and 5 km, running mostly along natural paths and forest trails. The event also includes community runs and children’s races ranging from 50 to 1,100 metres, making it appealing to a wide audience and families with children. It is organised by the Friends of the St. Wenceslas Run Association, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and high-quality organisation.

name: Běh Neumannovou stezkou
description: The Neumann Trail Run is a traditional running race organized by the T. J. Sokol Unhošť running club in the picturesque, wooded surroundings of Unhošť. The race offers an opportunity to enjoy sport in nature and is complemented by children’s races. Runners who register in advance receive a lower entry fee. The event has a long history and is held regularly in autumn.

name: MilešovKa(p)
description: MilešovKa(p) is a traditional 17.5 km running race from Teplice to Milešovka, with 846 m of elevation gain. The course follows asphalt roads, hiking trails, and dirt and forest paths, and is marked with the Czech Tourist Club’s red and blue trail markings. The race is open to the general public and offers awards for the top finishers in each category, hill climbers, and age-record holders. It is organized by SPONA Teplice, an association that supports amateur sport in the region. The results are announced alongside other running events in November.

name: Běh kolem Panské skály
description: The Run Around Panská skála is a popular trail race taking place on September 28, 2026, in Kamenický Šenov-Prácheň in the Liberec Region. The race offers 3 km and 6 km routes through hilly terrain around Panská skála and is part of the Českolipsko District Running League. The event is suitable for both recreational runners and experienced racers, offering a unique experience of running in nature with beautiful views.

name: Podzimní běh projektantů "Od hospody k hospodě"
description: The Designers’ Autumn Run “From Pub to Pub” is a traditional running event held in the picturesque surroundings of Krč Forest in Prague 4-Krč. The race is popular with runners and has been held for many years, welcoming all running enthusiasts and nature lovers. Organizers Pepa Krejčí and Honza Vočko warmly invite you to take part in this popular race, which offers an enjoyable experience in nature. Registration is available on race day, approximately one hour before the start.

name: Běh Karla Havlíčka Borovského
description: The Karel Havlíček Borovský Run is a traditional circuit race in Havlíčkův Brod, offering distances for different age groups, from the youngest children to adults. The route runs through Budoucnost Park and passes notable landmarks, including the memorial to the victims of the world wars and the statue of Karel Havlíček Borovský. The race is suitable for all age groups and features a mix of paved and unpaved paths with gentle elevation changes. The start and finish are at the elementary school at V Sadech 560, where showers and toilets are also available.

name: PUMA Třeboňský půl/maraton 10 a 5 km
description: The Puma Třeboň Marathon, Half Marathon, 10 km and 5 km races run through the unique natural landscape of the Třeboňsko Protected Landscape Area. The courses are flat with minimal elevation gain, mostly following paved cycling paths and forest trails, allowing runners to achieve personal bests in beautiful, peaceful surroundings. The race starts in Třeboň’s Renaissance square and passes through a historic gate into a nature reserve that is a candidate for UNESCO listing. The ideal October date offers pleasant running weather and a motivating atmosphere, with professional pacers on the course.

name: Run Berounka Run
description: Run Berounka Run is a relay race for teams and individuals that follows the Berounka River from Újezd u Svatého Kříže to Prague-Radotín. The 130 km route is divided into 6 legs, with over 3,100 metres of elevation gain, mainly on forest and field roads. The race starts on 3 October 2026 from 5:00 a.m. in several waves; the Ultra category starts the evening of 2 October. The race is open to teams of 2 to 6 runners and individuals in the Ultra category. Winners are announced in several categories, and refreshments are provided at the finish.

name: 24DS (24 Dlouhé Stráně)
